attorneys.name: Tony Abbatangelo
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal- DUI and Drugs Lawyers in LAS VEGAS, NV
attorneys.bio:
Tony Abbatangelo, a former judge, was born and raised in Las Vegas. Tony learned the law going to court with his father who was a very well known and legendary lawyer in Las Vegas. Tony’s experience as a judge and as a seasoned lawyer gives him a winning edge when it comes to representing the legal interests of clients. If you are in trouble with the law, you want Tony on your side. There are few attorneys that can bring the perspective and experience to serve a client’s legal interests like Tony can.

Tony graduated from Bishop Gorman in 1983 and received his law degree from the University of San Diego in 1990. A well respected lawyer, he has served on committees for the Supreme Court of Nevada and has made thousands of appearances in various courts throughout the Las Vegas valley.

attorneys.name: Jennifer V. Abrams
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Jennifer V. Abrams is Certified by the State Bar of Nevada as a Family Law Specialist and has been admitted to the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (AAML). She is one of only eleven Las Vegas divorce attorneys in the State of Nevada that has been accepted into this prestigious organization. Previously the Nevada Family Court Judges and Family Law Attorneys have elected attorney Jennifer V. Abrams to the Executive Council of the State Bar of Nevada, Family Law Section.

Ms. Abrams is admitted to practice law in three states, but chooses to practice exclusively in Las Vegas divorce matters. Jennifer Abrams is regarded as both a skilled negotiator and a forceful litigator. As such, she has earned the respect of her opponents as well as the Clark County Family Court Judges that oversee each Las Vegas divorce matter.

Fellow attorneys refer complex and substantial asset divorce cases to The Abrams Law Firm. Attorney Abrams routinely represents other lawyers or their spouses. The opposing party often retains more than one divorce lawyer to represent them against her in Contested Divorce matters.

Attorney Abrams is a member in good standing of the State Bar of Nevada, State Bar of Nevada Family Law Executive Council, Clark County Bar Association, American Bar Association, American Association for Justice, which is formerly the Association of Trial Lawyers of America, the State Bar of California, and the Louisiana State Bar (both inactive).

She received her Juris Doctorate degree, Magna Cum Laude, from the Pepperdine University School of Law in California, where she graduated 9th in a class of 255. She was a staff member of the Pepperdine Law Review for two years and has numerous awards and achievements including the American Jurisprudence Bancroft-Whitney Award and the CALI Excellence Award.

Jennifer received her undergraduate degree in Business Administration, Accounting Theory and Practice, from California State University, Northridge and has passed the Certified Public Accountants (CPA) examination.

Ms. Abrams earned a Juris Doctorate from the University of San Diego School of Law in 1995. While in law school, Ms. Abrams participated in the Civil Clinic and the Child Advocacy Clinic. Ms. Abrams practices in the areas of estate planning, trust administration and probate, and trust and probate litigation, as well as personal injury matters. She also practices in the areas of commercial and civil litigation, and bankruptcy, with a focus on creditor's rights.

Ms. Abrams has donated her time and legal skills as a member of the board of directors of Classrooms on Wheels, Inc. a non-profit organization that provides educational and medical services to under-served children in Nevada.

attorneys.name: Ilan Acherman Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Las Vegas Divorce Attorney Ilan Acherman

Attorney Ilan Acherman has excelled in representing clients in divorce and marital law matters for the past 13 years. Mr. Acherman’s experience includes both complex marital finances and child custody issues.

He has served as an attorney faculty member for the 2023 American Institute of Certified Public Accountants Expert Witness Program and as a co-instructor with Attorney Lianna Urfalyan for a State Bar of Nevada Continuing Legal Education (CLE) class on Alimony in Nevada.

Mr. Acherman is a strong advocate for children and the benefits educational opportunities provide to them. He has previously been appointed as a judge in the Truancy Diversion Program (TDP). The TDP is offered by the Eighth Judicial District Court to reduce absenteeism in Clark County schools in an effort to reduce the number of youth entering the formal juvenile justice system. TDP supports students and their families to address students’ school attendance, behavior and grades.

Ilan is a 20+ year resident of Las Vegas and has extensive experience with Nevada Court judges. He has worked as a Judicial Extern for the Honorable Stephanie Miley of Nevada’s Eighth Judicial Court. He has also served as a Judicial Law Clerk for Judge Sandra Pomrenze for the Eighth Judicial District Court, Family Division.

Attorney Acherman has been selected as a Super Lawyers Rising Star since 2018. Super Lawyers selects attorneys using a patented multiphase selection process. Peer nominations and evaluations are combined with independent research. Each candidate is evaluated on 12 indicators of peer recognition and professional achievement.

Mr. Acherman received his Bachelor of Arts from the University of Nevada Las Vegas (UNLV) in 2007 and subsequently earned his Juris Doctorate at the UNLV William S. Boyd School of Law in 2011. He was admitted to the State Bar of Nevada the same year and has focused his career on complicated divorce and marital law issues.

Attorney Acherman is admitted to practice in the Federal District Court, District of Nevada, and the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. Ilan is also bilingual and is fluent in English and Spanish.

attorneys.name: Robert M. Adams
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Honored as One of “The Top 100 Trial Lawyers” by The American Association for Justice.

Honored as a “Pillar of Justice” by The Nevada Justice Association.

Honored as a “Patron” by the Nevada Law Foundation.

A member of the “Million Dollar Advocates Forum.”

Robert leads the orthopedic litigation and trial preparation team at Eglet Wall Christiansen. In addition to supervising the litigation of hundreds of cases, Robert manages the trial preparation of most major cases at Eglet Wall Christiansen. Robert works closely with his partner Robert Eglet as second trial counsel in most of Robert Eglet's trials.

Robert has the distinction of being the only partner to work for the Firm before going to law school.

Born in Utah, but raised in Southern Nevada, Robert graduated from Rancho High School in Las Vegas. As an expert automotive machinist, he discovered his analytical mind served him well in recognizing and solving problems. His knack for exhaustively scrutinizing issues led to his career in law.

Robert received his undergraduate degree in Criminal Justice from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas. After receiving a Paralegal Certificate from the University of San Diego, Robert first worked for the Firm as a personal injury paralegal. He went on to study law at Whittier Law School in Southern California while continuing to work for the Firm during summer and holiday breaks. Robert gained more valuable career preparation in personal injure law as a clerk for the Police Litigation Unit of the Los Angeles City Attorney's Office.

An avid sports fan, Robert particularly enjoys football and auto racing.

attorneys.name: Nicholas M. Adams
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Adams graduated from the William S. Boyd School of Law in Las Vegas, Nevada. In addition to being named to the Dean's List three separate semesters, Mr. Adams was also presented with the CALI Excellence for the Future Award in Torts. Prior to law school, Mr. Adams studied at the University of Nevada-Reno, where he received a Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy.

Before joining Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Adams served as the law clerk to the Honorable Justice Douglas Herndon of the Nevada Supreme Court, where he was able to observe Nevada's appellate system and gain unique perspective regarding the processes that inform judicial decision-making. Thereafter, he served as the law clerk to the Honorable Judge Adriana Escobar of the Eighth Judicial District Court, where oversaw a docket dealing exclusively with civil matters. Between the two clerkships, Mr. Adams was able to observe all stages of litigation - from the filing of the Complaint, to a bench or jury trial, and lastly to the process of appeal.

When not practicing law, Mr. Adams primarily spends his time enjoying the company of his friends and family, spending time outdoors, or savoring a hot cup of tea and reading about his favorite subjects.

attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Aldrich has significant experience in commercial litigation, plaintiff personal injury law, and insurance defense litigation, including complex litigation. His experience also includes appellate matters and criminal defense. Mr. Aldrich worked three and one-half years at a 35+ lawyer law firm in downtown Las Vegas prior to starting his former firm, Aldrich & Bryson, LLP. Prior to that, Mr. Aldrich also clerked in the Clark County District Attorney’s Office. Mr. Aldrich has written more than 30 appellate briefs submitted to Nevada and Idaho appellate courts, and has successfully argued cases before the Nevada Supreme Court and the Idaho Court of Appeals.

Arbitration Experience

Mr. Aldrich has handled numerous arbitrations. Mr. Aldrich's best estimate is that he has handled more than 50 arbitration hearings.

Post-Trial Motion Experience

Mr. Aldrich has experienced handling post-trial motions such as motions to set aside judgments, motions for new trial, and the like.

Volunteer Work

Various years between 1995 - Present, Boy Scouts of America (Assistant Scout Master, Cub Scout Den Leader, etc.) Mr. Aldrich has been and continues to be a youth sports coach. He has coached and assisted basketball, flag football, soccer, and baseball.

Malpractice Insurance

Mr. Aldrich maintains malpractice insurance through StarStone Specialty Insurance Company. Mr. Aldrich has never been the subject of discipline, public or private, in Nevada, Utah, or Idaho.

attorneys.firm_name: Benson & Bingham Accident Injury Lawyers, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Reno, NV
attorneys.bio:
Todd was born in Petaluma, California on October 31, 1975, and was raised in Sparks, Nevada. He served in the United States Navy from 1995 – 1999, after which he attended the University of Nevada. In 2004, Todd graduated from the University of Nevada with a Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy. Todd then attended the University of Oregon School of Law, where he earned his Juris Doctorate degree in 2007.

While in law school, Todd served in an externship for the Honorable Robert A. McQuaid of the United States District Court in Reno. He then served as a summer law clerk for Lemons, Grundy & Eisenberg in 2006. After graduating from law school, Todd served as a law clerk for the Honorable Steven P. Elliott in the Second Judicial District Court for the State of Nevada. n 2010, Todd was elected treasurer of the Association of Defense Counsel of Northern Nevada. He served in that capacity for one year, and he currently serves as the Association’s vice president.

Todd became an associate attorney at Lemons, Grundy & Eisenberg from 2008-2022 practicing primarily civil litigation and insurance defense.

In 2022, Todd shifted his talents to well respected law firm Benson & Bingham Accident Injury Lawyers, LLC. Todd is licensed to practice law before all courts in Nevada and practices primarily in the areas of personal injury and accident law.

attorneys.name: David G. Alleman
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Alleman practices primarily in real estate, corporate and commercial transactions. He assists businesses with formation, licensing and governance matters, as well as general business contracts and mergers and acquisitions. He also assists banks, businesses, homebuilders and developers in a wide range of real estate matters, including the acquisition and disposition of land and improved property, finance and leasing.

Mr. Alleman received a Bachelor of Arts in International Relations, with a minor in German, from Brigham Young University. He received his Juris Doctor Degree from the J. Reuben Clark Law School at Brigham Young University, graduating cum laude.

Mr. Alleman was admitted to practice in Nevada in 2002. Prior to joining Marquis Aurbach to chair the firm’s transactional department, Mr. Alleman was a shareholder at a large Nevada firm, practicing in real estate, corporate and commercial transactions.

Mr. Alleman is an Eagle Scout and has volunteered in many capacities with the Boy Scouts of America. He is active with local church youth groups and currently serves as a leader of a large church group of young single adults. He has been very active in coaching youth sports and served most recently as the Vice President of Summerlin South Little League (SSLL). He served as an SSLL board member for six years and coached several of its All-Star teams, including, most recently, the 2017 Majors All-Star team that won the Nevada state championship and represented Nevada in the West Regional Tournament in San Bernardino. Originally from Southern California, he is an avid Raiders, Angels and Lakers fan.

Craig Anderson is the president, as well as a shareholder and co-chair of the firm’s litigation department. His practice focuses on civil rights defense and serious personal injury claims including wrongful death and premises liability. Mr. Anderson has extensive trial experience having tried more than 40 jury trials in both federal and state court. He has obtained defense verdicts in cases involving police shootings, wrongful deaths, and medical malpractice. Mr. Anderson has also resolved many cases in his client’s favor through motion practice, having obtained summary judgment for his clients in over 50 cases. Finally, Mr. Anderson has argued over 25 appeals before the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals and has argued in front of the Nevada Supreme Court.

Mr. Anderson was admitted to the State Bar of Nevada in 1999 and joined Marquis Aurbach in 2001. In his spare time, Mr. Anderson enjoys spending time with his wife, Lanta, and their children. His other interest includes working out.

attorneys.name: Phillip S. Aurbach
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
I have been a lawyer for over 45 years. Most of my practice has been litigating contract, real estate, and business disputes including non-compete agreements and partnership/corporate breakups. During the last 15 years about 20% of my time is spent arbitrating and mediating disputes privately and for the American Arbitration Association (AAA). I also spent 17 years as a Nevada Supreme Court Settlement Judge. I try to negotiate or mediate a resolution for my clients, but when the other side will not settle, I use my litigation skills to resolve the dispute.

In addition to practicing law, I try to help young attorneys become better lawyers by writing articles and by lecturing for the Nevada Bar Association, the Clark County Bar and various national legal education companies on various topics such as trial strategy, evictions, mortgage and trust deed foreclosures. I also authored two chapters of the Nevada Civil Practice Manual relating to prejudgment and postjudgment remedies.

I have lived in Vegas most of my life. My dad was a pit boss at the Desert Inn when it opened in the 1950's. He sent for my mom, my sister and me from Florida when I was two. Except for college, I've been in Vegas ever since.

I was a paper boy at age 14 delivering newspapers at 3:30 am every morning on my bicycle. In high school, I wasn't a gifted athlete, so I worked after school and on weekends practicing tennis. I couldn't afford to pay for tennis instructions, so I strung tennis rackets and washed tennis courts in exchange for lessons. I managed to get a scholarship to play college tennis. I paid my own way through college with a tennis scholarship and a work-study program. In 1973, I earned a degree in Business Administration with a Finance emphasis. I worked for a year at a bank and decided to go to law school, but Nevada didn't have a law school at that time.

I went to the University of San Diego School of Law where I served as Research Editor of the San Diego Law Review, worked odd jobs and took out student loans to pay for law school.

After graduating in 1977, I came back to Vegas and got my first job as Deputy District Attorney in the Clark County District Attorney's Office. I then entered private practice and learned how to practice law from some of the best lawyers in town. There were less than 1,500 attorneys in Las Vegas at that time and most attorneys were happy to share their experience.

attorneys.firm_name: The Bach Law Firm, LLC & Education Rights Group
attorneys.practice_type: Higher Education Students' Rights & Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Jason was born in Peoria, Illinois and was raised in the Chicago suburbs. After graduating high school, he attended Johnson & Wales University in Providence, Rhode Island. In college, he founded and was President of the Johnson & Wales University Chapter of the American Civil Liberties Union, and also sat on the Board of Directors of the Rhode Island ACLU and Rhode Island Coalition Against the Death Penalty. Upon graduation from JWU, he was honored as Civil Libertarian of the Year by the ACLU chapter he founded, and was awarded the university's Senior Service Award, given to the graduating senior who contributed the most to student life during their tenure at the university. In 2009 Jason was honored as an Alumni Leader by the university.

After college, Jason enrolled as part of the Charter Class of the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, Boyd School of Law. He once again founded a chapter of the ACLU, at the Boyd School of Law, and served as its President for three years. For three consecutive years Jason received a Community Service Scholarship, awarded by the Boyd School of Law. He graduated from UNLV with his Juris Doctorate in May 2002, and was also awarded the Dean's Award for Outstanding Service. Jason also studied abroad in 2001 at Oxford University, New College, in Oxford, England.

Jason has been admitted to practice law in the State of Texas, the State of Nevada, the District of Columbia, the United States District Court, District of Nevada, the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit, and the United States Supreme Court. He has also sat on the Board of Directors of the ACLU of Nevada, and is currently a member of the American Bar Association, American Association for Justice, National Association of Criminal Defense Attorneys, and the Student Press Law Center. In August 2008 the Board of Governors of the State Bar appointed Jason to the Fee Dispute Arbitration Committee. Jason has also been an instructor in Education Law at the University of Texas School of Law and Austin Bar Association's People's Law School.

Published articles written by Jason include: An LRIS Success Story, 15-Mar Nev. Law. 40 (March 2007) (Nevada Lawyer, State Bar of Nevada); Educating the Educators, Communique (Clark County Bar Assoc.), September 2004; Students Have Rights Too: The Drafting of Student Conduct Codes, 2003 BYU Educ. & L.J., 1 (Winter 2003); Student Without Rights: The Elimination of Constitutional and Civil Rights, As They Apply to Minors, 8-Jan Nev. Law. 19 (Jan. 2000) (Nevada Lawyer, State Bar of Nevada); and Cracking the Code, Nevada Journal, July 1999.

When he is not working, he enjoys spending time with his family and friends and watching baseball, in particular the Chicago White Sox.

Christian Balducci is a trial attorney. His practice primarily focuses on complex commercial litigation and the defense of healthcare providers. His experience includes jury and bench trials, arbitrations, and regulatory board representation. Christian has prosecuted, and defended, multi-million dollar claims on behalf of his clients. Christian has also represented clients in government investigations.

After graduating from Arizona State University with a Bachelor of Arts in Justice Studies, Christian attended the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada—Las Vegas where he graduated Magna Cum Laude. During law school, Christian served as a judicial extern to the Honorable Abbi Silver and later worked as a law clerk at a national catastrophic injury defense firm. Christian also served as a law clerk to the Honorable Susan Scann of the Eighth Judicial District—Business Court in Las Vegas, Nevada. As a law clerk in one of only five Business Courts in Clark County, he assisted Judge Scann with handling a docket of over 750 business and general civil cases.

In his spare time, Christian spends time with his wife, Ali. He is also an avid tennis and ice hockey player.

attorneys.name: Zachary Balkin
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Zachary Balkin moved to Reno in 2021 to be closer to his family and joined Lerner and Rowe in 2022 to ensure that a National Law firm would be represented in Reno by an attorney who lived in the area, not an attorney that commuted from Las Vegas.

Mr. Balkin graduated from the University of Texas at Austin in 2001 with a degree in Biological Sciences and a minor in business. He received his Juris Doctorate degree from Golden Gate University Law School in 2007 with a Certificate of Specialization with Distinction in Litigation as well as several other academic awards.

Between 2008 and 2016, Mr. Balkin worked for Colorado’s 13th Judicial District Attorney’s office where he was promoted to Chief Deputy District Attorney, the second-highest non-elected position in the office. While with the District Attorney’s Office, Mr. Balkin prosecuted more than 45 Jury trials, including homicides, sexual assaults, and crimes against at-risk adults and children. His trial experience gave him insight, knowledge, and experience, not only in how to try and win a case, but also the importance of managing every aspect of a case to ensure the chances of winning at trial.

In 2016, Mr. Balkin joined the largest personal injury firm in Colorado, bringing years of trial experience and courtroom knowledge along with him. Mr. Balkin settled millions of dollars worth of claims for his firm’s clients in Colorado and was eventually asked to manage the firm of over 50 attorneys. In his time in Colorado, Mr. Balkin helped hundreds of clients navigate the difficult waters of a claim against an insurance company and ensured that his clients interest always came first. Mr. Balkin was also a part of several large successful class action lawsuits brought against companies such as Hewlett Packard and Wells Fargo.

Mr. Balkin brings a dearth of knowledge, trial experience, and compassion for his clients to Northern Nevada. Like all attorneys at Lerner and Rowe, Mr. Balkin prides himself on positive client experiences and holding insurance companies to the highest standards. His desire to ensure that his clients are treated fairly by insurance companies literally runs through his blood, as his father was also a personal injury attorney.

In his off time, Mr. Balkin can be found reading books to his son or snowboarding and hiking the mountains with his fiancé. He is licensed to practice law in the states of Nevada, Colorado, and Illinois as well as The Supreme Court of the United States, U.S. District Courts of Nevada and Colorado, and the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals.

attorneys.practice_type: Probate and Trust Administrations Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Jonathan Barlow is a managing partner at Barlow Flake, Attorneys at Law. Mr. Barlow received his Juris Doctor degree from the nation’s oldest law school, the College of William & Mary School of Law, in May 2006 and was licensed to practice law in Nevada in October 2006. At William & Mary, Mr. Barlow served as Notes Editor for the William and Mary Law Review, a top 20 legal periodical, and also as a teaching assistant. Prior to law school, Mr. Barlow earned his Honors Bachelor of Arts degree, cum laude, from the University of Utah, majoring in Political Science.

Mr. Barlow has focused his practice on probate and trust administrations and disputes, as well as estate and business planning. He also has extensive litigation experience, having tried three cases in District Court and having litigated and settled numerous other disputes. During his time away from the practice of law, Mr. Barlow serves as a lay ecclesiastical leader of a Henderson-area congregation.

Outside of the office, Ms. Barrett enjoys spending time with her daughter and dog, traveling, and attending community charity events.

attorneys.name: Christian Barton
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Christian Barton joined Morris, Sullivan & Lemkul as an associate attorney in October, 2017. Mr. Barton advises and represents clients in the areas of complex civil litigation, class action, personal injury, environmental law, bankruptcy law, insurance defense litigation, medical malpractice and gaming law. Mr. Barton also represents appellate clients in the foregoing legal areas, and is the co-author of an appellate brief which resulted in a per curiam opinion from the Nevada Supreme Court in favor of his client. Mr. Barton has had the pleasure to serve as general counsel for businesses headquartered in California and Nevada, including a large, regional petroleum distributor; one of Las Vegas' premier resort and casinos; and, a rising Southern California brewery. In his capacity as corporate counsel, Mr. Barton has represented businesses before the Nevada Gaming Commission, California Labor Commissioner, and the Workers' Compensation Appeals Board.

Prior to joining Morris, Sullivan & Lemkul, Mr. Barton was an associate for an Inland Empire law firm, where he focused primarily in areas of personal injury and employment litigation. Mr. Barton has also served as an adjunct professor at California Western School of Law, teaching Advanced Legal Analysis classes to second year students.

Mr. Barton earned his Bachelor of Arts in Social Science from University of California, Irvine. Thereafter, he obtained his Juris Doctor from California Western School of Law, where he graduated magna cum laude, was an associate editor of the California Western Law Review, competed on the trial team, served as a volunteer small claims court mediator, and received numerous academic awards.

During law school, Mr. Barton also externed with three judges in the U.S. District Court, Southern District of California and with the late Justice Alex C. McDonald of the California Court of Appeal, Fourth District, Division One.

Mr. Barton is admitted to practice law in California and Nevada, all U.S. District Courts in California, and the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado.

attorneys.name: Qumars Behzadi
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation & Appeals Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Qumars Behzadi earned his Juris Doctor degree from the University of Notre Dame Law School in 2000. Once he passed the bar, instead of jumping right into a single-lawyer practice, he began his decades-long career as a lawyer defending clients on behalf of insurance companies. This ensured Qumars understood exactly how insurance companies operate in the legal space for claims. Knowing how the insurance companies handle cases gave him a unique viewpoint and understanding that many lawyers never see outside of fighting insurance companies for their clients.

Subsequently, Qumars set out on his own and started his own practice in 2007, hoping to more effectively realize his passion for helping individuals assert their rights against insurance companies and employers alike. Qumars is licensed in both Nevada and Hawaii, and has represented numerous clients in state and federal courts at all levels of litigation. He has recovered over $40 million on behalf of his clients and has won over 95% of his cases. Qumars treats every client with respect and integrity, seeking justice and compensation on their behalf.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
About Ed

Edward M. Bernstein, Esq. is the owner and founding partner of Edward M. Bernstein & Associates, and one of the most recognizable figures in Nevada.

Ed is one of state’s premier Las Vegas personal injury attorneys and has hosted The Ed Bernstein Show for over 31 years. He has served the Las Vegas community for decades with dozens of community appointments and terms of service. In the year 2000, he was Nevada’s Democratic nominee for the United States Senate.

Ed received his B.A. from Long Island University in 1971 and his J.D. from Widener University in 1975. Since then, Ed’s professional accolades include numerous publications, honors and awards, court appointments, and has been named one of America’s Top 100 High Stakes Litigators.

One of Mr. Bernstein’s most notable accomplishments is his television show, simply entitled The Ed Bernstein Show. He has proudly hosted it for over 25 years, and it has since become the longest-running show in Nevada’s history, airing every Sunday.

Ed’s achievements

Edward M. Bernstein is the owner of Edward M. Bernstein & Associates, a law firm with offices in Las Vegas.

He has served as a Judge Pro Tem for the City of Las Vegas Municipal Court and for the City of North Las Vegas. He was the Democratic candidate for the United States Senate in 2000. He has been appointed by the Governor to serve as a hearing officer for the State of Nevada Personnel Advisory Commission as well as a hearing officer for the State of Nevada Department of Administration and the Nevada Board of Psychological Examiners. He is active in serving on committees within the Nevada State Bar, such as the Professionalism Committee and Southern Disciplinary Board and has in the past served as a member of the Nevada State Bar Fee Dispute Committee; Nevada State Bar Lawyer Referral Service Committee and Nevada State Bar Judicial Fund-Raising Practices Study Committee.

He is a member of the Nevada Justice Association, having served on its Board of Governors. He is also a member of the Clark County Bar Association and a past member of the Clark County Bar Professionalism Committee. He has been appointed by United States District Court Judge, Lloyd George to serve on the Federal Civil Justice Reform Act Advisory Group for the District of Nevada and as a member of the Supreme Court Community Relations Committee. He was also appointed by the City Council to serve on a Citizen’s Priority Advisory Committee and appointed by the Mayor to serve on the Clark County Regional Flood Control Citizen’s Advisory Committee and the downtown Las Vegas Business Partnership Committee.

Speech and Publications

Ed has been honored for his recognition on behalf of his work with MADD on numerous occasions. He has been the recipient of the Clark County Bar Association’s Professionalism Award, the Citizen Committee on Victims’ Rights Award, the American Muslim Women of Nevada Community Service Award and honored by the Executive of the Year presented by the Professional Secretaries International (PSI). He has been honored for his community achievement by the Women’s American ORT and recognized by Outstanding Young Men of America and Distinguished Men in Southern Nevada.

Community Appointments & Service

Since 1989, Ed has been the moderator and host of The Ed Bernstein Show, a 30-minute television talk show, which is the longest running television talk show in the State of Nevada and airs on the NBC affiliate in Southern Nevada. He was also the host of a 30-minute radio program on K-NEWS, which featured prominent Southern Nevadans discussing legal, political and local issues.

Ed has been very active in the community, especially with reference to diversity and minority and medical issues. He has served as an executive board member and is a former presiding chairman of The National Conference (formerly National Conference of Christians and Jews). He was a member of the Committed 100 Men, where he has been a mentor to an African-American boy, who does not have a father. He was a regional board member of the Anti-Defamation League, an organization that fights racism and bigotry worldwide. He has served as a board member of Temple Beth Sholom since 1986 and served as its president for three years. He has served as a director of the Jewish Federation of Las Vegas, and he is an honorary board member of the Catholic Jewish and Christian Student Center at UNLV. His activism in working with diversity in our community has resulted in Ed acting as a moderator for an educational forum regarding minority concerns and working as a founder of the Community Coalition to ease community tensions after the L.A. riots.

He has worked for over ten years to put a stop to drinking while driving with MADD, wherein he and Sandy Heverly developed the first Red Ribbon campaign, which become a national prototype as well as the first Home For The Holidays campaign, which offered free taxi rides over Christmas and New Years to those who had been drinking. He has also produced PSAs and was active as a spokesperson for MADD then STOP DUI.

For several years he has been a Board Member and spokesperson for the Crohn’s and Colitis Foundation of America, and he is the founder of The Edward Bernstein Charitable Foundation and The Bernstein Family Fund for IBD at the Cleveland Clinic.

Honor & Awards

In addition to being a spokesperson for MADD, Ed has spoken before various community groups including Rotary Clubs; US Small Business Association; Hadassah-Hebrew University Medical Center; The American Marketing Association and Toastmasters, as well as speaking at various public and religious schools. Ed speaks on a variety of topics ranging from ethics, community responsibility, law and marketing. He has spoken on numerous occasions to students at UNLV on law and/or marketing. He has been a contributing writer to Journal of Psychology; Sentinel Voice; El Mundo, Imagenes Magazine; Nevada State Bar Journal, Inter Alia; Clark County Bar Publication, and The Communiqué.

attorneys.bio:
Why did you become an attorney? From a young age the thought of becoming an advocate always appealed to me. The mere idea of having a profession, the education, and the ability to appear in court to present an argument lured me in. Upon turning 16 and obtaining a drivers license, I obtained employment as a runner at a law office. I maintained the same employment until the end of my college days at UNLV. Gaining experience from the attorneys and familiarizing myself with the court house. The influences I received throughout that opportunity sealed the deal. After college it was straight to law school. The practice of law presents challenges on a daily bases far from the mundane 9-5. Frankly, my personality is incapable of a day to day desk job without lashing out. The constant argument with insurance adjusters and defense attorneys over liability issues and medical records, fighting for what's right, suits me well.

attorneys.name: Elliot S. Blut
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Elliot S. Blut is a partner of Blut Law Group, PC with extensive practice in all major areas of business, Probate, Trust and Estate litigation. Mr. Blut has extensive trial and appellate experience in state and federal courts in California and Nevada.

Mr. Blut received his B.A. degree from the University of California, San Diego in political science in 1989 and his Juris Doctor from Hastings College of the Law in 1992. Mr. Blut is a member of the State Bars of California and Nevada, and is admitted to practice in all California State Courts. Mr. Blut is also admitted to practice in numerous federal courts throughout the United States, including the United States District Court for the Central District of California, the United States District Court for the Eastern District of California, the United States District Court for the Northern District of California, the United States District Court for the District of Nevada and the United States Tax Court. Mr. Blut is further admitted to practice before the United States Court of Appeal for the Ninth Circuit.

With 30 years of experience, Mr. Blut has represented hundreds of clients in a wide variety of matters. These include representation in business and commercial litigation matters, including contract disputes, partnership disputes, franchise disputes, business fraud claims, real estate, lender liability and issues surrounding residential lending and wrongful foreclosure. Mr. Blut also has particular expertise in the area of probate and trust litigation and estate planning. The probate and trust litigation experience includes representing heirs, executors and other estate administrators, trust beneficiaries, and trustees in litigating trust and estate disputes. Mr. Blut’s litigation experience has included numerous jury trials and bench trials as well as binding arbitration. Mr. Blut has represented national mortgage lenders and servicers in foreclosures, collections, Bankruptcy and litigation for violation of foreclosure statutes, fraud, unfair business practices and quiet title actions.

Mr. Blut’s estate planning experience has covered a wide range of estates from an individual with limited assets to larger estates implementing more sophisticated planning techniques including life insurance trusts, generation skipping trusts, qualified personal residence trusts (“QPRT”), qualified terminable interest property marital trusts (“QTIP”), grantor retained annuity trusts (“GRAT”), and intentionally defective grantor trusts in connection with a sale of a family owned business.

attorneys.name: Jerome R. Bowen
attorneys.practice_type: State and Federal Civil Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
JEROME R. BOWEN was born in Denver, Colorado on May 22, 1963. He received his Bachelor of Science Degree from University of Utah in 1988. During which he attended honors programs at Cambridge University in England, George Washington University, and the American University in Paris, France. After receiving his undergraduate degree, he returned home to his native Idaho to attend law school at the University of Idaho. He received his Juris Doctorate in 1991. While at the University of Idaho, he was a member of the Idaho Law Review 1990-1991 and had a published case note. After receiving his law degree, he was selected to act as a Special Assistant to Cecil D. Andrus, Governor of Idaho in 1991, where he was the governor's liaison to five (5) State of Idaho departments, including budgeting and the governor's state agenda.

Prior to starting his own practice Mr. Bowen worked for eight years for the law firm of Harrison, Kemp & Jones, Chtd. in which he primarily practiced in the areas of complex insurance litigation including but not limited to auto, premises and property claims, insurance defense, bad faith, slip-and-fall, construction defect litigation, products liability, and medical malpractice for both plaintiffs and defendants.

Mr. Bowen is currently a member of the State Bar of Nevada, Clark County Bar Association, Nevada Trial Lawyers Association, Association of Trial Lawyers, and the American Bar Association. He is currently admitted to practice before all Nevada state and U.S. District courts, as well as the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit and the Nevada Supreme Court.

attorneys.name: Kim Boyer
attorneys.practice_type: Probate & Estate Administration Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Kim Boyer is Certified as an Elder Law Attorney by the National Elder Law Foundation. She practices in the areas of probate, trust administration, elder law, estate planning, guardianships, trusts, powers of attorney, and other estate planning matters. Ms. Boyer received her A.B. degree in Mathematics, summa cum laude, from San Diego State University, and her law degree magna cum laude, from the University of San Diego School of Law. During law school, she was an editor of the law review and was elected to membership in the Order of the Coif.

Ms. Boyer is licensed to practice in Nevada, and is admitted to the U.S. District Courts for the District of Nevada and the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. She is a member of the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, the National Guardianship Association, and is an accredited attorney with the Veterans Administration. She is co-author of the book Alzheimer’s and Dementia: A Practical and Legal Guide for Nevada Caregivers, published by the University of Nevada Reno Press. Ms. Boyer publishes a monthly newsletter addressing issues facing seniors and their families, and is a frequent speaker on aging and elder law topics. Ms. Boyer is one of three attorneys in Nevada registered with the Nevada State Bar as a certified specialist in Elder Law.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Kim Boyer is Certified as an Elder Law Attorney by the National Elder Law Foundation. She practices in the areas of probate, trust administration, elder law, estate planning, guardianships, trusts, powers of attorney, and other estate planning matters. Ms. Boyer received her A.B. degree in Mathematics, summa cum laude, from San Diego State University, and her law degree magna cum laude, from the University of San Diego School of Law. During law school, she was an editor of the law review and was elected to membership in the Order of the Coif.

Ms. Boyer is licensed to practice in Nevada, and is admitted to the U.S. District Courts for the District of Nevada and the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. She is a member of the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, the National Guardianship Association, and is an accredited attorney with the Veterans Administration. She is co-author of the book Alzheimer’s and Dementia: A Practical and Legal Guide for Nevada Caregivers, published by the University of Nevada Reno Press. Ms. Boyer publishes a monthly newsletter addressing issues facing seniors and their families, and is a frequent speaker on aging and elder law topics. Ms. Boyer is one of three attorneys in Nevada registered with the Nevada State Bar as a certified specialist in Elder Law.

attorneys.name: Mr. Douglas R. Brown Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: Benson & Bingham Accident Injury Lawyers, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Reno, NV
attorneys.bio:
A native of Reno, Nevada, Doug Brown brings a disciplined perspective to personal injury law, shaped by his service in the United States Marine Corps from 1989 to 1993. Following his military tenure, he returned to Nevada to begin his academic journey, graduating from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas with a B.A. in Political Science in 1997, and subsequently earning his Juris Doctor from the University of the Pacific, McGeorge School of Law in 2001.

Doug’s early career was defined by prestigious clerkships that provided a behind-the-bench view of the Nevada legal system. He served as a legal extern for the Honorable Howard D. McKibben and later as a law clerk for the Honorable William A. Maddox in Nevada’s First Judicial District Court. These experiences laid the groundwork for his admission to the Nevada State Bar in 2001.

Before joining the team at Benson & Bingham Accident Injury Lawyers, Doug honed his skills in complex civil litigation as a partner and shareholder at Lemons, Grundy & Eisenberg. His courtroom record is extensive, having navigated: More than 12 jury trials to verdict, Significant experience in high-stakes arbitrations and mediations, Strategic advocacy in complex civil disputes.

Doug is recognized by his peers for the highest level of professional excellence, holding the AV Preeminent® rating from Martindale-Hubbell. His commitment to the legal profession is reflected in his active membership in the Washoe County Bar Association, the American Bar Association, and the American Inns of Court.

Beyond the courtroom, Doug is a dedicated advocate for Nevada’s natural resources. He is the founder and director of Truckee River Public Waters, a nonprofit organization focused on protecting and improving public access to local lands.

Doug remains deeply connected to his Reno roots. When he isn't advocating for clients, he is likely fly fishing, bird hunting with his dog, Rosebud, or enjoying the outdoors with his wife, Leslie.

Awards and Honors

AV Preeminent® rating by Martindale-Hubbell

attorneys.name: Natalie Burns
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Natalie Burns is an accomplished attorney at Michaelson Law, specializing in estate planning, asset protection, trust administration, and probate. She is licensed to practice in both Nevada and Utah and is accredited by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs to assist claimants with pension benefit claims.

A Las Vegas native, Natalie graduated cum laude from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV) with a degree in Psychology. She went on to earn her Juris Doctorate from the J. Reuben Clark Law School at Brigham Young University in Provo, Utah.

Before joining Michaelson Law in 2015, Natalie gained valuable experience in criminal defense and social security disability law. However, she discovered her true passion in estate planning, where she takes pride in helping individuals and families navigate the complexities of planning for the future.

Natalie’s dedication to her clients is deeply personal. After caring for her mother, who lived with dementia for many years before passing in 2022, Natalie developed a profound understanding of the challenges families face when dealing with illness, disability, and loss. Her empathy and personal insight enable her to provide compassionate and comprehensive guidance to her clients.

Outside of her legal practice, Natalie is devoted to her family and community. She is married and the proud mother of three daughters. Natalie serves in her church’s women’s organization and enjoys cooking, baking, dancing, music, biking, and all things Disney.

attorneys.name: Jerry S. Busby
attorneys.practice_type: Auto and Truck Liability Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Jerry S. Busby, a partner in the firm, is based in the Las Vegas office. Jerry has more than twenty-eight years of trial experience and concentrates his practice on liability matters, including premises liability, product liability, auto and truck liability, insurance coverage litigation, Uninsured and Underinsured Motorist, and malpractice or professional liability.

Jerry began his legal career defending civil personal injury cases and has continued to do the same type of work since 1984. He tried his first civil case in 1985 for a grocery store and has since tried close to 100 other civil cases - the majority of which were premises liability cases. Jerry has been retained as an expert witness in the field of premises liability on a few occasions - and speaks Spanish which is helpful in communicating with witnesses in the cases he litigates.

Jerry graduated with Honors from Brigham Young University, with a B.S. in Business Administration with an emphasis in Finance (1981). He graduated with his Juris Doctorate from Arizona State University in 1984. He has taught various continuing education seminars in the field of defending personal injury litigation.

Jerry is a member of the Nevada State Bar and is currently licensed to practice in all Courts, State and Federal, in the State of Nevada. He is also a member of the Arizona State Bar, but does not actively practice in Arizona at this time.

Jerry is a member of the American Bar Association, the Federation of Defense and Corporate Counsel, the American Board of Trial Advocates, the Defense Research Institute, and the J. Reuben Clark Law Society.

attorneys.name: Vissia Calderon
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration & Naturalization Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Our attorney, Vissia Calderon, is a Filipino immigrant who has made the United States her new home, and providing quality, competent and affordable legal representation to her clients her mission.

She practiced law in her native country, the Philippines, for more than 10 years, representing individuals, multi-national companies and small businesses before trial and appellate courts and various administrative agencies. After passing the California bar in 2007, Vissia Calderon decided to concentrate in the area of immigration law. Being an immigrant herself, Vissia Calderon relates to immigrants from all backgrounds and national origin. She is committed to helping reunite U.S. families with their relatives from abroad, U.S. businesses bring in talented people from across the globe, and immigrants become US citizens through the naturalization process. She believes in providing competent, efficient and affordable legal representation for businesses, families and foreign nationals coming to the U.S., and is fully committed to providing no less than that kind of representation to her clients.

attorneys.bio:
Mr. Calaway is a commercial litigator who advocates for his clients both in and outside of the courtroom, in state and federal court, and at the trial and appellate levels. An experienced litigator who is more familiar with large and complex cases, Mr. Calaway's understanding of and experience with every stage of a case as it moves through the judicial system serves his clients well. His experience allows him to represent clients from start to finish, providing keen insight and astute precision of both the law and procedure.

Mr. Calaway represents both plaintiffs and defendants in a broad range of complex commercial and corporate litigation areas. His diverse practice areas include: corporate disputes, partnership disputes, business combination disputes, securities and stock transfer disputes, intellectual property disputes, trade secret disputes, contract disputes, business tort disputes, natural resource and water disputes, as well as construction and real estate disputes.

Mr. Calaway graduated from the University of Utah where he received a Bachelor of Science degree in Economics and received his Juris Doctorate degree from the University of Idaho College of Law. While in law school, he served as the Managing Editor for the Law Review and earned the Wallis, Randall Law Scholarship. In addition to being selected Dean's List, Mr. Calaway received CALI Excellence Awards in Constitutional law and Legal Writing, and received the Extraordinary Service Honors award for pro bono work.

Before joining Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Calaway served as a judicial extern for the Honorable United States District Court Judge B. Lynn Winmill where he was able to observe all stages of litigation including several high-profile jury trials. Mr. Calaway also worked as a summer associate for a well-known trial lawyer law firm that specializes in high-stakes cases.

When not practicing law, Mr. Calaway spends his time with his wife and three children. He can often be found outdoors riding motorcycles, playing sports, or hitting ski-slopes.

attorneys.name: Hector J. Carbajal II
attorneys.practice_type: Civil, Business, and Complex Commercial Litigation Services Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Hector J. Carbajal II is the founder of Carbajal Law. Prior to forming Carbajal Law, Mr. Carbajal co-founded Smith Carbajal in September 2017 and previously served as a partner at Carbajal & McNutt, LLP from February 2006 through August 2017. Before that, he was a shareholder at the prominent Las Vegas firm Lionel Sawyer & Collins, where he began his legal career as an associate attorney in September 1997.

Mr. Carbajal focuses his practice on complex civil and business litigation, representing clients in high-stakes disputes involving business torts, breach of contract claims, corporate governance and shareholder conflicts, covenants not to compete, product liability matters, health care disputes, entertainment-industry litigation, and other sophisticated commercial controversies.

A seasoned trial lawyer, Mr. Carbajal has prosecuted and defended major multi-party cases as well as complex civil matters in state and federal courts nationwide. His courtroom advocacy and strategic judgment have earned the respect of clients and peers alike. He routinely guides clients through every stage of litigation, from early case assessment through discovery, motion practice, trial, mediation, settlement conferences, and appeals, always with a focus on achieving the best possible outcome.

Mr. Carbajal has been recognized as a Super Lawyers selectee for 2017-2025, an honor awarded to a limited percentage of attorneys in each state based on independent research, peer nominations, and professional achievement.

In his spare time, Mr. Carbajal is an avid outdoorsman.

attorneys.name: Robert Cerceo Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Robert Cerceo is a highly experienced attorney with a well-established statewide family law practice. Known for his expertise and dedication, he has been providing exceptional legal services to clients for many years. Before becoming an attorney, Robert gained valuable experience in various industries, including banking, the Department of Defense, and the arts. These diverse experiences have provided him with unique insights into different sectors, enhancing his ability to navigate complex legal matters effectively.

Practice

Since the year 2000, Bob has wholeheartedly dedicated his legal practice exclusively to Family Law. Through his unwavering commitment and expertise, he has firmly established himself as one of the pioneering Nevada certified family law specialists. Recognizing his exceptional knowledge and skills, Bob has been honored with appointments as a fellow to both the esteemed American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (AAML) and the prestigious International Academy of Family Lawyers (IAFL).

Moreover, Bob's invaluable contributions extend beyond his practice. For a span of 10 years, he played a significant role in the legal community by diligently handling Pro Tem Juvenile Court overflow dockets, handling cases related to truancy, delinquency, and dependency. This firsthand experience has further enriched his understanding of the intricacies of Family Law.

Demonstrating his unwavering commitment to staying at the forefront of Family Law, Bob continuously contributes as a prolific writer and captivating speaker on various Family Law topics. His passion for sharing knowledge and insights further exemplifies his dedication to serving his clients and the legal community alike.

attorneys.name: Peter James Christiansen
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
I have 38 years experience defending people in criminal matters. I began my legal career with the Clark County Public Defender's office in 1975. I have been a member of the Nevada Bar Association since 1976. I was a team chief for 26 of the 28 years I worked for the Clark County Public Defender's Office. In that capacity I supervised a team of 5 to 6 attorneys. I also trained new attorneys. In addition to my administrative and supervisory obligations, I always carried a case load that averaged between 100-150 clients and any given time. I also ran the appellate section of the Clark County Public Defender's Office from about 1978-1985.

I retired from the Public Defender's Office in 2003 and went to work for my son's law office, Christiansen Law Office. For the past 10 years I have continued to practice exclusively criminal law in the Nevada state courts all over the state of Nevada.

I also serve on the Clark County Committee to appoint Justices of the Peace.

attorneys.name: Augustus Claus
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Claus started out litigating in the federal courts and traveled year around. He has had cases all across the United States. After the years he decided to settle down and has since made Las Vegas his home. Mr. Claus has been practicing law in Nevada for over 16 years.

Since the start of his state practice here in Nevada, he has successfully defended every kind of criminal case from Capital murder (Death Penalty) to misdemeanors. He has had numerous high-profile cases that have been covered by multiple major news stations including Fox, ABC News, CBS News, 13 Action News, The Review Journal, The Las Vegas Sun, 8 news now, The New York Post, USA Today, and many more.

Mr. Claus went to college for accounting, engineering, and the law and received his law degree with honors from Lewis and Clark Law School. Since starting his practice he has become one of the most formidable opponents to the State District Attorneys’ Office and has successfully overturned wrongful convictions at the Nevada Supreme Court, exposed corrupt police officers. Mr. Claus has created case law that is still the defining work in areas such as self-defense, and is now known in the Las Vegas community as the “Peoples Advocate”.

Mr. Claus is also respected by his peers and was awarded the Presidential Commendation Award by the Nevada Attorneys For Criminal Justice for his unwavering devotion to his clients and to the law. Eventually, he was nominated and voted by his fellow defense attorneys to become the president of this elite group of defense attorneys. As president of the Nevada Attorneys For Criminal Justice, Mr. Claus was recognized again for his Outstanding Service and Leadership of the Nevada Attorneys for Criminal Justice. Amongst other major awards, he was named the 2022 Best Litigation Attorney.

attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Chad F. Clement, a shareholder with the law firm Marquis Aurbach, is a litigator and trial lawyer. He represents a broad array of clients, from global companies and foreign individuals, Fortune 500 companies, and middle-market companies, to small businesses, start-ups and entrepreneurs, and individuals. Mr. Clement regularly represents clients in obtaining favorable outcomes in complex disputes, both inside and outside the courtroom. He has significant experience in multiple practice areas, including complex business and commercial disputes, contract disputes, business and other intentional torts, real estate and title litigation, intellectual property, trade secret, bankruptcy proceedings, and similar litigation.

Mr. Clement earned his bachelor of arts in political science from Brigham Young University. He earned his juris doctor from Southwestern Law School. During law school, Mr. Clement was a Dean’s Fellow, a member of the Moot Court Honors Program, and an articles editor for the Journal of International Media & Entertainment Law. He placed as a top oralist and writer in Southwestern’s Intramural Moot Court Competition, and went on to place second in the National Telecommunications Moot Court Competition in Washington D.C.

Prior to joining Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Clement was a law clerk to Justice Nancy M. Saitta of the Nevada Supreme Court. Mr. Clement was also an extern to the Honorable Patrick J. Walsh, United States District Court, Central District of California.

When he is not practicing law, Mr. Clement enjoys spending time with his wife and their three young daughters, and just about any other activity that gets him out of the office, including fishing, sports, and the outdoors.

He represents a broad array of clients, from global companies and foreign individuals, Fortune 500 companies, and middle-market companies, to small businesses, start-ups and entrepreneurs, and individuals. Mr. Clement regularly represents clients in obtaining favorable outcomes in complex disputes, both inside and outside the courtroom. He has significant experience in multiple practice areas, including complex business and commercial disputes, contract disputes, business and other intentional torts, real estate and title litigation, intellectual property, trade secret, bankruptcy proceedings, and similar litigation.

Mr. Clement earned his bachelor of arts in political science from Brigham Young University. He earned his juris doctor from Southwestern Law School. During law school, Mr. Clement was a Dean’s Fellow, a member of the Moot Court Honors Program, and an articles editor for the Journal of International Media & Entertainment Law. He placed as a top oralist and writer in Southwestern’s Intramural Moot Court Competition, and went on to place second in the National Telecommunications Moot Court Competition in Washington D.C.

Prior to joining Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Clement was a law clerk to Justice Nancy M. Saitta of the Nevada Supreme Court. Mr. Clement was also an extern to the Honorable Patrick J. Walsh, United States District Court, Central District of California.

When he is not practicing law, Mr. Clement enjoys spending time with his wife and their three young daughters, and just about any other activity that gets him out of the office, including fishing, sports, and the outdoors.

attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Nick Crosby practices primarily in labor and employment law, municipal liability, constitutional law, civil rights defense and general civil litigation. For nearly 20 years, Mr. Crosby has represented management in labor disputes, to include labor arbitrations concerning discipline, discharge, contract interpretation and interest arbitration, as well as representation before the Employee-Management Relations Board and both state and federal court.

A native of Reno, Nevada, Mr. Crosby attended the University of Nevada, Reno where he received a bachelor of arts degree, with distinction, in journalism with an emphasis in advertising and a minor in marketing. After attending University of Nevada Reno, Mr. Crosby received his juris doctorate from the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada Las Vegas. While at Boyd, Mr. Crosby competed on the National Moot Court Team, advancing to the national finals in 2004 and graduated in the top third of his class. Prior to joining Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Crosby served as a judicial extern for the Honorable Michael Douglas during his tenure as a District Court judge. Mr. Crosby is admitted to practice in all courts in the state of Nevada, the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit and the United States Supreme Court.

In his spare time, Mr. Crosby enjoys hunting, camping, traveling and spending time with his wife, Kara, and their 6 sons.

attorneys.name: Emily Cunningham
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Emily K. Cunningham, originally from the Pacific Northwest, proudly calls Las Vegas her home. After her father relocated to Las Vegas when she was twelve, she spent her summers in Las Vegas. She moved full time to Vegas during high school, graduating from Arbor View High School. Emily earned her degree in political science from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV), graduating cum laude with department honors in 2014. She continued her education at the UNLV William S. Boyd School of Law, graduating in 2017.

During her time in law school, Emily developed a strong desire to practice in areas that positively impact people’s lives, but she could not pinpoint what area of law would be the best fit for her. Following law school, Emily gained valuable experience working as a law clerk for civil judges at the Las Vegas Justice Court, where she witnessed the practical application of civil procedure—often involving debt collection cases—and the critical role attorneys played in the outcome of the cases. Her exposure to the many different forms of debt collection cases motivated her to advocate for those who needed help the most.

Inspired by a letter she penned to her future self during her final semester of law school, Emily pursued a career in personal injury law, driven by her passion for helping others. Since practicing personal injury, she has guided clients through every step of the legal process, from initial consultations to trial completion.

Emily’s journey into litigation was serendipitous; while assisting a colleague with jury instructions during a trial, she caught the attention of a partner at her prior firm, which led to her involvement in several significant trials. These resulted in noteworthy verdicts, including $7 million against a driver who hit a pedestrian, a $101 million verdict against the pedestrian’s insurance company for mishandling the claim, a $13.2 million verdict for a traumatic brain injury case, and a groundbreaking $550 million award—which included $500 million in punitive damages—for a DUI-related fatality.

Emily’s proudest moment in her litigation career thus far came when the daughter of the deceased victim in the DUI-related fatality trusted her enough to open up emotionally just days before trial. This emotional connection allowed the daughter to support her reserved mother in expressing her feelings. The candid testimony from both women resonated powerfully with the jury, a testament to the bond Emily forged with the family

Known for her personable and quirky demeanor, Emily believes that empathy and authenticity are key to connecting with clients and jurors alike. Outside of her legal work, she enjoys spending time with her husband and their six rescue dogs, focusing on providing loving homes for those who are not easily adoptable.

attorneys.name: Gabriel Czop
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Gabriel Czop

Workers’ Compensation Attorney

Gabe is an alumnus of the William S. Boyd School of Law in Las Vegas, Nevada. There, he earned a Cali award (highest grade in the class) in Trial Advocacy and was on the Dean’s List. In 2015, throughout law school, Gabe was a student editor for the nationally recognized textbook Law and Religion, Cases, and Materials.

Gabe worked for a Personal Injury law firm and a Civil Rights law firm, learning and honing the skills he uses every day for his clients in court. After graduating and passing the bar exam, Gabe began his career as an Insurance Defense attorney. In this role, he learned how insurance companies litigate cases in various state and federal courts throughout Nevada.

The insight he gained made the transition to a plaintiff’s attorney easier. As a plaintiff’s attorney, Gabe has had tremendous success both in and out of the courtroom. Gabe is an experienced trial attorney as well as a zealous advocate in nonbinding arbitrations. As a Workers’ Compensation attorney at Shook & Stone, Gabe brings the same determination and keen attention to detail that made him so successful in his trials. Gabe is currently licensed before all Nevada state courts, the Federal District Court for the District of Nevada, and the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals.

attorneys.name: Christian L. Delgado
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Delgado, born and raised in Las Vegas, Nevada, graduated from the William S. Boyd School of Law in Las Vegas, Nevada. Prior to law school, Mr. Delgado left his hometown to study at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Arizona where he received a Bachelor of Arts in Politics, Philosophy, Economics, and Law; with a minor in Philosophy. During his undergraduate career, Mr. Delgado excelled working in the area of sales where he received numerous awards and accolades including holding store sale records for the month of June and July 2015. Mr. Delgado chose to pursue a career in law after an undergraduate classmate of his noticed Mr. Delgado’s apt for persuasive oral argument and suggested him to consider a career in law.

Mr. Delgado attended Golden Gate University School of Law in San Francisco, California where he achieved Dean’s List for two consecutive semesters and obtained a CALI award for academic excellence in Criminal Law as a first-year law student. Thereafter, Mr. Delgado transferred to his hometown school of UNLV Boyd School of Law where he obtained his second CALI award for academic excellence in Constitutional Law. He graduated from UNLV Boyd School of Law in 2021, sat for the July 2021 Nevada bar examination, and passed on his first attempt.

Before joining Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Delgado practiced law in a wide scope of practice areas but primarily specializes in business litigation, premises liability, and landlord/tenant law. In Mr. Delgado’s early years of practice, he has gathered extensive court-room experience including sitting second-chair at a jury trial his first year of practice; arguing and obtaining multiple favorable arbitration awards for his clients; and achieving favorable settlements at mediation and/or at the doorsteps of trial.

When not practicing law, Mr. Delgado pursues his passion for cars and professional motorsports. He strives to integrate his passions with his career in law to benefit the Las Vegas professional and grass-root motorsports communities.

attorneys.name: Charles C. Diaz
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Charles Diaz is a partner in both the Reno and Las Vegas offices, primarily practicing criminal defense law and workers compensation law. Mr. Diaz is an accomplished trial and appellate attorney that has successfully represented countless injured workers and criminal clients in local, state and federal courts. Before forming his own law firm, Mr. Diaz was a Washoe County, Nevada, Public Defender for over five years. His extensive trial experience, coupled with the professional relationships he has formed over the past 20 years, allows Mr. Diaz to identify and focus on the details of each client's case that will bring the best results possible.

Mr. Diaz was born and raised in Los Angles, California and has been a Nevada resident for over 25 years. He earned his Bachelor's Degree from Loyola Marymount College, Los Angeles, California and earned his Juris Doctorate Degree, from the Nevada School of Law, Old College, Reno, Nevada, in 1986. He is licensed to practice in both Nevada and California, as well as state and federal courts. Mr. Diaz is a member of the State Bar of Nevada, State Bar of California, American Bar Association, National College for DUI Defense, Nevada Justice Association, National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, Washoe County Bar Association and the Clark County Bar Association.

Mr. Diaz also speaks fluent Spanish.

attorneys.name: Brian P. Eagan
attorneys.practice_type: Probate Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Brian P. Eagan is a partner of the Firm, focusing primarily in fiduciary matters, including probate, trust and estate administration and related litigation. Mr. Eagan also negotiates and drafts premarital agreements and has a background in domestic relations law. He is admitted to practice in Nevada.

Mr. Eagan represents professional and private fiduciaries, creditors and beneficiaries, having successfully resolved disputes both in and out of court. Mr. Eagan assists trustees, personal representatives and administrators fulfill their legal obligations, and finds creative solutions to complex administrative matters in uncontested trust and estate proceedings. Mr. Eagan routinely appears before the Probate Court of the Nevada Eighth District Court. He has both prosecuted and defended will and trust contests and litigated issues of undue influence, competency and breach of fiduciary duty.

Mr. Eagan received a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of Virginia in Charlottesville. Mr. Eagan also obtained his Juris Doctor degree from The American University, Washington College of Law, in Washington, D.C., where he served as the Managing Editor of The Journal of Gender, Social Policy & the Law. After law school, Mr. Eagan returned to his hometown of Las Vegas. He is a graduate of Bishop Gorman High School.

Mr. Eagan is an active member of the Probate and Trust Section of the Nevada State Bar and currently chairs the committee responsible for revising the probate rules for the Eighth Judicial District Court. Mr. Eagan also served on the executive committee of the LGBT Law Section for the Nevada State Bar, the Board of Directors of NevadaGIVES and the Las Vegas Steering Committee of the Human Rights Campaign. He is also a graduate of the Las Vegas Metro Chamber of Commerce's Leadership Las Vegas program.

SuperLawyers named Brian a Top Rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney. Avvo also rated Brian a "Top Attorney" and gave him a "Superb" rating, and the Nevada Business Magazine has recognized Brian as one of the Legal Elite.

In his free time, Mr. Eagan enjoys spending time with his husband and their two young children.

These are only a sampling of the reasons Eglet Wall Christiansen's Senior Partner, Robert Eglet, is the most respected and sought after trial attorney in Nevada. A testament to this is that Robert receives referrals from hundreds of attorneys from around the United States to try their cases for them.

Robert heads the trial team at Eglet Wall Christiansen, and is the lead trial counsel on all major cases.

Robert is a past President of The Nevada Trial Lawyers Association and served on its Board of Directors for three years. Robert is the past Vice-Chairman of the Nevada Law Foundation where he served as a member of the Board of Trustees for 6 years. Robert is on the Executive Committee for The National Trial Lawyers Association and is a member of the Board of Trustees for the Nevada Access to Justice Commission. Robert also serves on the National Advisory Board of the Association of Plaintiff Interstate Trucking Lawyers of America and is their Regional Director for Nevada, Utah, Arizona and Colorado. Robert is a sustaining pillar of Justice of the Nevada Justice Association (NJA) and a Guardian of Justice of the NJA.

Robert is routinely asked to lecture around the country to various trial attorney organizations and bar associations on trial practice for product defect, large catastrophic injury and death cases.

A resident of Nevada since childhood, Robert graduated from Western High School in Las Vegas. Thereafter, Robert earned a degree in economics, with honors, from the University of Nevada. Robert went on to receive his law degree from the University of the Pacific, McGeorge School of Law, where he graduated in the top 10% of his class. Robert is also a graduate of Hastings School of Law College of Trial Advocacy and the National College of Trial Advocacy.

After completing his legal education, Robert returned to Las Vegas joining one of Nevada’s oldest and most prestigious law firms where he spent the next four years developing his skills as a trial attorney. Robert then started his own law firm specializing in defending personal injury, insurance bad faith and wrongful death cases. Over the next decade Robert successfully built his firm from two to twelve attorneys, becoming one of the most respected defense firms in Nevada. At the same time, Robert continued to try countless cases.

In 2000, Robert sold his defense practice to his partner and began his partnership with his current partners where he specializes in representing the significantly injured, victims of product defects and defective drugs, commercial trucking accidents, insurance bad faith and wrongful death clients.

When Robert is not pursuing the rights of injured victims, he and his wife Tracy Eglet, also a Partner with Eglet Wall Christiansen, split their time between their three grown children and the charitable organizations they support.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Honored as One of “The Top 100 Trial Lawyers” by The American Trial Lawyers Association.

Member of the “Million Dollar Advocates Forum.”

Honored as a “Pillar of Justice” by The Nevada Justice Association.”

Honored as a “Patron” by the Nevada Law Foundation.

Managing Partner of Eglet Wall Christiansen.

Tracy is considered by her peers as one of the most successful female attorneys in Nevada. As everyone at Eglet Wall Christiansen will proudly admit, Tracy is the smartest and most efficient lawyer in the Firm.

Not only is Tracy’s legal knowledge beyond comparison, but she redefines multi-tasking. Tracy leads the largest team at Eglet Wall, the Catastrophic Injury Unit, managing the litigation of hundreds of multi-million dollar cases. Her skill, strategy, and tenacity in preparing a case for trial positions her clients to obtain the highest value on their cases.

She also is the best negotiator in the Firm and handles all of the large settlement conferences, mediations and settlement negotiations. As if this wasn’t enough, Tracy is also the Managing Partner supervising more than 50 employees and the day to day operations of the Firm.

Tracy also manages to find time to not only prepare large complex cases for trial, but to work closely with her husband and partner, Robert Eglet, in trying many of these cases.

Tracy Eglet (Mendola) grew-up in Buffalo, New York where she was born in 1967 graduating from high school at age 16. She went on to earn her Bachelor of Science Degree in Political Science from Canisius College. Thereafter, Tracy earned her Law Degree from Ohio Northern University College of Law. She then began her legal career in Columbus, Ohio where she practiced for four years before relocating her practice to Nevada.

Tracy is licensed to practice in Nevada, Ohio, the Federal Courts of Nevada and Ohio as well as the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals.

Tracy genuinely cares about her clients, which shows in the amount of time and effort she devotes to their cases. She is proud to be partners with, who she believes, are the best lawyers in Nevada.

Tracy also manages to devote a significant amount of pro bono (free) legal work for the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada, Children’s Attorneys Project providing representation to child victims of abuse and/or neglect.

Tracy also makes sure there is time outside the Firm to spend with her partner in life as well as law, Robert Eglet and their three children, Keegan, Blake and Jordan.
