attorneys.name: Gary L. Fales
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Gary Fales’ estate planning practice focuses on helping families achieve harmony and security for their future. His considerable legal experience includes wealth preservation, family protection and charitable planning as well as planning strategies for unmarried couples and divorced individuals. Gary has a broad range of experience in helping families of all types find peace of mind through creative trust planning.

After graduating from law school in 2001, Mr. Fales joined KPMG’s New York City Mergers and Acquisitions Tax Practice, where he performed M&A tax due diligence, conducted extensive tax research on complex transactions and wrote technical tax memos and opinion letters, including cross-border transactions.

In the spring of 2002, Gary moved back to his hometown of Las Vegas where he began helping families and small businesses plan for incapacity, death and lawsuits.

Mr. Fales holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Economics from Brigham Young University and a law degree also from Brigham Young where he was a member of the Law Review Board. He is a member of the bar in Connecticut, Idaho, Nevada and New York. Gary is a member of WealthCounsel, a national organization of trusts and estates attorneys and other legal, tax and business professionals who engage in sophisticated planning techniques.

A frequently requested lecturer for financial planners, CPAs and other attorneys on a variety of topics including family wealth planning, wealth preservation, and asset protection, Gary enjoys educating his community. Gary has chosen to concentrate on the Trusts and Estates area because he is passionate about helping families achieve harmony and security for their future.

Gary is happily married to his wife, Christine, and they have four wonderful children: Sariah, Nathan, Melissa and Jacob.

Awards and Honors

Honors

7x Best of Las Vegas Award-Winner

attorneys.name: Kyle Fenton
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio: Kyle is a licensed attorney practicing with the law firm of Albright, Stoddard, Warnick & Albright. Kyle was born in Texas but spent his childhood living in eight different states across the country, as Kyle’s father works in the hotel industry which required frequent moving. Kyle graduated high school from the Punahou Academy in Honolulu, Hawaii, which features esteemed alumni such as Barack Obama and Steve Case. After graduating high school and receiving a perfect score on his SAT writing exam, Kyle spent two years at UCLA before transferring to the University of Minnesota, where he graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree in Political Science with distinction in 2019. Kyle then moved to Las Vegas to attend the William S. Boyd School of Law, University of Nevada - Las Vegas on a merit-based scholarship, where he graduated with cum laude distinction in 2022. While in law school, Kyle earned CALI awards in both Constitutional Law II and Resort, Hotel, Casino Law, meaning that he received the highest grade in the class. While also in law school, Kyle externed for the Honorable Timothy C. Williams, worked as a law clerk for a local personal injury firm, and served as the Treasurer of the Federalist Society at Boyd for two years. Since graduating and becoming licensed to practice law, Kyle has worked as an associate attorney practicing in civil litigation, personal injury law, business law, contract law, and homeowner’s association law. While not working for his clients, Kyle enjoys watching football, spending time with his family and friends, and traveling.

Mr. Flake enjoys public speaking and marketing and has presented numerous seminars on bankruptcy, estate planning and other legal topics. Mr. Flake currently serves as a board member for the Old Vegas Ranch Homeowners Association.

attorneys.practice_type: Corporate Law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Hannah Gagow joined Marquis Aurbach as a law clerk in May 2024 and continued working as a law clerk up until she passed the bar and became a licensed attorney in 2025. Originally from Orange County, California, Hannah found home in Las Vegas after earning her Juris Doctor from William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.

During law school, Hannah served as President of the Mock Trial Team and competed across the United States. She also served as a Notes Editor for the Gaming Law Journal where her student note article was selected for publication. Before joining the firm, Hannah worked in Family Law and served as an advocate for the Children’s Attorneys Project, representing foster children across Las Vegas. Prior to entering law school, Hannah earned her Bachelor of Science in Political Science and Sports Broadcast Journalism from Texas Christian University, graduating Magna Cum Laude. While attending Texas Christian University on an academic scholarship, she was a member of the cheer team for four years. (Go Frogs!)

Outside of her practice, Hannah enjoys watching baseball, being outdoors, and spending time with her two Labradors.

attorneys.name: Marialice K. Galt
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation, DUI / DWI, Criminal Law, Personal Injury, Wrongful Death, Subrogation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Marialice Galt, a partner in both the Reno and Las Vegas offices, has represented injured workers for over 19 years. Ms. Galt has personally litigated and handled more than two thousand workers compensation cases. Before becoming a partner in the law firm, Ms. Galt worked for three years with Nevada Attorney for Injured Workers. Attorney Galt is a skilled appellate attorney and has successfully appealed many cases to the Nevada District Courts and the Nevada Supreme Court. Ms. Galt is further distinguished by being one of the few attorneys in the state of Nevada who has ever appealed a workers' compensation case to the Supreme Court of the United States, receiving the distinguished honor of Attorney and Counselor of the Supreme Court of the United States.

A lifetime Nevadan, and co-founder of Good Earth Restaurants, Inc., Ms. Galt earned her Bachelor's Degree in Criminal Justice from the University of Nevada, with a minor in Spanish. She earned her Juris Doctorate Degree from the Nevada School of Law, Old College, Reno, Nevada, in 1989, after completing her final year at Lewis & Clark, Northwestern School of Law, in Portland, Oregon. Ms. Galt is a member of the State Bar of Nevada, Washoe County Bar Association, Clark County Bar Association, American Bar Association, the Nevada Justice Association, and the National Association of Subrogation Professionals.

Ms. Galt was a Clerk for the Honorable Mark Handelsman, Second Judicial District Court. She also served for seven years on the Washoe County District Board of Health.

attorneys.name: Gerald I Gillock Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Gerald (Jerry) Gillock is the founder of Gillock & Coggeshall, a law firm in Las Vegas, Nevada. A top-rated, award-winning trial lawyer with more than 50 years of legal experience, Jerry focuses his practice primarily on medical malpractice, wrongful death, and personal injury claims. He also has significant experience handling insurance bad faith matters.

Over the course of his career, Jerry has achieved notable success advocating on behalf of those who suffered an injury or lost a loved one as the result of someone else's negligence or wrongdoing. Jerry has over 300 jury trials to his name.A personable and compassionate lawyer, Jerry has earned a reputation as a fierce advocate for his clients. He finds great reward in being able to help people through some of the most difficult times in their lives while assisting them in securing the maximum amount of finances to cover their medical bills, lost wages and other related expenses.

In recognition for his exemplary professionalism and outstanding legal abilities, Mr. Gillock holds an AV-Preeminent peer-review rating from Martindale-Hubbell, and the Nevada Trial Lawyers Association voted him Trial Lawyer of the Year in 2003. He has received many other accolades from his peers along with countless positive testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients.

A 1966 graduate of California State University at Long Beach, Mr. Gillock obtained his Juris Doctor from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law in 1970. Along with practicing before all Nevada state courts, he is also admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit.

A leader in his legal community, Mr. Gillock has served as both President and Vice President of the Nevada Trial Lawyers Association as well as a member of its Board of Governors and co-chair of the organization's Committee on Medical Malpractice. He is also an active member of the Clark County Bar Association, the State Bar of Nevada, and the American Trial Lawyers Association.

attorneys.name: Dara J. Goldsmith
attorneys.practice_type: Probate Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Dara Goldsmith was born and raised in Southern California. She enrolled at California State University Northridge at the age of 16, earning a Bachelor of Arts in Economics in 1987. While at Northridge, Dara was active in a wide range of campus and community activities and was selected the University's 25th Homecoming Queen.

After graduating from Northridge, Dara attended Pepperdine University School of Law, where she earned a Juris Doctor in 1990, followed by a Masters of Laws in Taxation (LL.M.) from the University of Miami (1991 curriculum/1994 thesis).

After completing her coursework at the University of Miami, Dara moved to Las Vegas, where she passed the Nevada Bar Exam and began her legal career. Dara joined forces with Marjorie Guymon to establish Goldsmith & Guymon in 1996. Dara is also licensed in California, Arizona, and Hawaii.

Dara has been involved in many professional and philanthropic organizations throughout her career, including serving on the Nevada State Bar Board of Governors, as President of the Clark County Bar Association, and as Chairperson of the Nevada Community Foundation and of the Nevada Law Foundation/Justice League.

In addition to being recognized as a Nevada Super Lawyer, a Mountain States Super Lawyer, and one of the Top 50 Women Mountain States Super Lawyers, Dara has received numerous awards, including the Nevada Legal Services Pro Bono Guardianship Attorney of the Year, the Presidential Award and the Medal of Justice from the State Bar of Nevada, and the Lloyd D. George Award of Professionalism from the Clark County Bar Association and State Bar of Nevada.

Dara holds an AV Preeminent rating, the highest rating possible as voted by her peers, and recognized through Martindale Hubbell.

Dara is an accomplished swimmer and triathlete and can often be found in a pool, ocean, lake, or river. A competitive swimmer on Las Vegas Masters Swim Team, Dara competes in pool and open water meets throughout the country. She has also completed dozens of triathlons and the distance running events.

Dara is married to Michael Goldsmith. They have two adult sons who share their love of travel, exploration and adventure, open water swimming, skiing, scuba diving and trekking.

Ross C. Goodman is the founder and president of Goodman Criminal Defense Attorney, a boutique law firm, committed to providing diligent and individualized attention to each client. Ross C. Goodman, Esq. has worked diligently for over twenty (20) years in successfully defending against felony and misdemeanor charges in federal and state courts.

A board-certified criminal defense attorney, Goodman Criminal Defense Attorney has extensive trial experience, a proven trial record, and has earned numerous awards for his professionalism and client reviews. He has been recognized by all the national organizations including The National Trial Lawyers as one of the Top 100 Trial Lawyers, Superlawyers, and holds an AV-Preeminent peer review rating* from Martindale-Hubbell, so you can rest easy knowing your case is in the best hands possible.

Ross C. Goodman is dubbed as the go-to criminal defense lawyer in Las Vegas due to numerous cases that he defended -- most of them are considered as high-profile. His practice areas include:

Casino Markers

DWI / DUI

Domestic Violence

Drug Crimes

Sex Crimes

As a Las Vegas native, Goodman Criminal Defense Attorney takes pride in extricating clients from what is often times the lowest point in their lives with the end result of avoiding jail time or loss of employment. To find out more about how Ross C. Goodman, Esq. can best serve your unique situation, you can contact his law office or visit his website to schedule a free initial consultation.

attorneys.name: Michael Graves
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Michael Graves is a seasoned litigator with extensive experience in both federal and state courts, specializing in complex commercial litigation. Over his career, Michael has developed a reputation for crafting effective litigation strategies in high-stakes cases. His work has included representing a Bankruptcy Trustee in adversary actions, managing large-scale civil cases involving multiple defendants and millions of dollars in controversy, and handling hundreds of insurance defense cases. These cases have ranged from racketeering and large-scale property loss to wrongful death and catastrophic injury claims.

Michael’s path to the legal profession has been anything but conventional. He graduated from the College of William & Mary in Williamsburg, Virginia, in 1991 with a Bachelor of Arts in Economics. Following college, he served as a Captain in the United States Marine Corps, where he co-piloted KC-130 Hercules missions and was stationed in Okinawa, Japan, for four years.

After his military service, Michael transitioned to the financial sector as a financial planner and business owner. His company evaluated the risks and merits of plaintiffs’ lawsuits, reviewing over 2,000 personal injury cases and 300 commercial cases. In this role, he provided expert witness testimony to the IRS in its arbitration program.

Michael earned his Juris Doctor from the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, in 2008 and began practicing law shortly thereafter. In addition to his legal practice, Michael purchased and operated a homeowners association management company in 2015, overseeing 15 employees and managing 50 HOAs. He successfully sold the company in 2019.

A resident of the Las Vegas area since 1998, Michael is deeply engaged in his community. Outside of work, he enjoys traveling, practicing martial arts, and competing as one of the top-ranked chess players in Nevada.

attorneys.name: Nathan Grubin Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Originally from Los Angeles, Nathan graduated from Johnson & Wales University in Charlotte, North Carolina, summa cum laude, with a Bachelor of Science in Sports, Entertainment, & Event Management in 2019. After graduation, Nathan worked for a sports marketing firm in Los Angeles for the year up until the Covid-19 Pandemic.

In the summer of 2021, Nathan relocated to Las Vegas to attend the William S. Boyd School of Law at UNLV. During law school, he served as an Articles Editor for the Gaming Law Journal and participated in the Kid’s Court community service program, progressing from volunteer in his first year to courtroom supervisor by graduation. He also externed for Judge Timothy Williams of the Eighth Judicial District Court and the UNLV General Counsel’s Office.

Nathan joined John Park Law as a law clerk in the summer of 2023 and is now an attorney at the firm.

When Nathan is not in the office, he likes to spend his free time catching up on the latest in television and movies. Nathan also enjoys golfing on the weekends and hanging out with friends.

attorneys.name: Marjorie A. Guymon
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Following graduation from Weber State University in 1990 with a Bachelor of Science in English and a Business Minor, Marjorie obtained her law degree from J. Reuben Clark Law School at Brigham Young University in 1993, where she was active in the Student Bar Association. She obtained the highest grade in her bankruptcy class, which interest lead to her subsequent focus in the bankruptcy field of law.

Following law school, Marjorie was an associate at Timothy S. Cory & Associates from 1993 to 1995 when she opened her own law firm. She subsequently opened the firm of Goldsmith & Guymon, P.C. with Dara J. Goldsmith in 1996. She practices primarily in bankruptcy, business law, estate planning, family law, guardianship, probate and trust administration. Marjorie is licensed in Nevada and Utah, admitted to practice in both state and federal courts in both jurisdictions. She is also admitted to practice before the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals and the U.S. Supreme Court.

Marjorie has practiced law in the Las Vegas area in excess of 20 years during which time she has served the community providing significant pro bono legal services. Among other accolades, she received the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada Pro Bono Attorney of the Year Award in 2011, while her firm has received the Clark County Pro Bono Law Firm of the Year Award in 2001, Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada's Lied Award for most pro bono cases taken by a law firm in 2008, and the Clark County Pro Bono Project's Law Firm of the Year in 2008.

Marjorie is also actively involved in various legal organizations, such the American Bar Association, State Bar of Nevada, Clark County Bar Association, Southern Nevada Association of Bankruptcy Attorneys, Southern Nevada Association of Women Attorneys, the American Bankruptcy Institute, the National Association of Consumer Bankruptcy Attorneys. Additionally, she holds an AV rating which is the highest rating as voted by her Peers and recognized through Martindale Hubbell. She holds an AVVO rating of 10, also the highest rating possible given by the public, as well as the AVVO Public Choice Award. She has been rated by Super Lawyers and listed among Whose Who for Excellence in Legal Service.

When not working, Marjorie spends her time with her husband and son with whom she travels, snow skis, wake surfs, bikes, and volunteers time to her church.

attorneys.name: Cammy Ha
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Cammy graduated from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, with a Bachelor of Science degree in Hotel Administration and a Minor in Finance. After graduation, she worked as a hotel manager in Los Angeles, CA for two years. Subsequently, she returned to Las Vegas to attend law school. While in law school, she participated in one of the legal clinics as a student attorney and she was the president for a student organization. She externed for judges in both the Clark County District Court and the U.S. District Court. Cammy was the judicial law clerk for the Honorable Denise Gentile for several years, where she gained valuable knowledge and experience in the areas of family and guardianship matters. After her judicial clerkship, Cammy practiced family law and she is licensed in the State of Nevada. Presently, Cammy practices in the areas of estate planning, trust administration, probate, guardianship, and general business matters.

In her free time, Cammy enjoys going on hikes with her family and her dog. Cammy is fluent in both Cantonese and Mandarin.

attorneys.name: Tye S. Hanseen
attorneys.practice_type: Business law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Tye Hanseen is a shareholder and dedicated attorney at MACLAW, where he specializes in providing expert legal counsel to clients navigating the complexities of governmental entities, business law, real estate law, tort defense (e.g., premises liability, wrongful death, security), personal injury, HOA litigation, special investigations, and appeals.

He is admitted to practice in the United States Supreme Court, the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, and all Nevada courts, including the Nevada Supreme Court and Nevada Federal District Court. With over two decades of legal expertise, he has managed hundreds of matters, which have provided a wealth of knowledge and expertise. Throughout his career, Mr. Hanseen has honed his skills both inside and outside the courtroom, navigating a diverse array of legal challenges with precision and effectiveness. He is fair, persuasive, and strategic in his ability to secure favorable outcomes for his clients. He also has a deep understanding of negotiation tactics and alternative dispute resolution methods. Further, Mr. Hanseen has demonstrated a strong commitment to staying at the forefront of legal developments and industry trends.

His dedication and multi-faceted approach allows him to tailor legal strategies to the unique needs and objectives of each client, whether advocating for them in high-stakes litigation, complex legal transactions, or skillfully negotiating favorable settlements. Mr. Hanseen’s commitment to his clients and practice, coupled with his breadth of experience, instills confidence in his clients, reassuring them that they have a dedicated advocate who will go above and beyond to achieve their goals and protect their rights and interests.

He is truly committed to achieving the best possible outcomes with integrity, professionalism, and a steadfast commitment to excellence. The results speak for themselves, as his primary clients are a Fortune 500 company, a Fortune 1000 company, and a multi-billion-dollar privately held company. He also represents real estate agents/brokers, land developers, construction companies, HOAs, small businesses, business professionals, trucking and insurance companies, and governmental entities. With a passion for advocating on behalf of his clients and a commitment to delivering exceptional results, Mr. Hanseen has established himself as a trusted legal advisor in these fields.

Mr. Hanseen enjoys a life outside of his professional pursuits. Prior to law school, he was offered college scholarships for football and baseball. He ultimately chose baseball and competed at the Division 1 level in what was arguably the best and most feared baseball conference in the country. Thereafter, he spent time playing in the Atlanta Braves organization before retiring to pursue interests and aspirations he believed were more worthy of his time and talents. Since 2001, Mr. Hanseen has lived in Las Vegas. He has also spent time in California, Utah, Oregon, Wisconsin, and South America. He is actively involved in his community, desires to make a meaningful impact in the lives of others and believes in developing a strong worth ethic and understanding the role of failure in learning and growing. He enjoys working on non-legal related projects, participating in and watching sports, outdoor activities, competition, and friend/family focused holidays.

attorneys.name: Kevin M. Hanratty Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Hanratty obtained a degree in Chemistry with a minor in Biochemistry with honors from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in December 1997. After obtaining a scholarship in May 1998, Mr. Hanratty attended Whittier Law School in Costa Mesa, California. In May 2001, Mr. Hanratty obtained his Juris Doctor (J.D.) Degree (Cum Laude) from Whittier Law School where he finished in the top 12% of his class of over 200 candidates. Mr. Hanratty also received Whittier Law School's Intellectual Property Certificate for course work in the areas of Trademarks, Copyrights, Patents, and Trade Secrets.

Mr. Hanratty has been a member of the Nevada Bar and has practiced in Las Vegas, Nevada since October 2001. Mr. Hanratty initially worked for a Large Insurance Defense Firm where he concentrated on all aspects of civil litigation including catastrophic personal injury, real estate litigation, contract litigation, landlord/tenant disputes, evictions, and business/corporate/LLC disputes. It was during this time, Mr. Hanratty gained invaluable knowledge of the tactics of the insurance companies in defending personal injury lawsuits. Thereafter, Mr. Hanratty determined to represent those less fortunate individuals that are significantly injured due to the another parties negligence.

As a direct result in December 2003, Mr. Hanratty decided to focus his practice to represent persons injured in accidents including auto accidents, motorcycle accidents, slip and falls, drunk driver collisions, wrongful death claims, uninsured/underinsured claims, pedestrian/automobile accidents, bike/automobile accidents, dog bites/dog attacks, defective products, truck accidents, and serious and catastrophic injuries.

Since his admission, Mr. Hanratty has represented only a select and limited number of clients at any given time in a diligent effort to provide each and every client the strongest, most aggressive, and best representation available. If you are looking for an attorney that will diligently work to provide you the strongest, most aggressive and best representation available, please contact our office located in the heart of Las Vegas for a free confidential consultation.

attorneys.name: Brian R. Hardy
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Hardy’s areas of practice include: civil litigation, insurance defense, business litigation, formation & licensing; real estate; administrative & regulatory law; campaign & election law; First Amendment & defamation; legislative affairs; intellectual property; constitutional law and eminent domain.

Mr. Hardy returned to Marquis Aurbach after serving as vice president and general house counsel for a prominent firearms group. Prior to joining the firm, Mr. Hardy served as a judicial extern to the Honorable Federal District Court Judge James C. Mahan. While working for the Federal District Court, Mr. Hardy assisted the Judge Mahan in his services as Judge Pro Tempore on the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals in Pasadena, California. Mr. Hardy has successfully handled jury and bench trials obtaining multi-million-dollar judgments on behalf of his clients. Moreover, Mr. Hardy has represented local, national and international clients and has filed on behalf of his clients petitions and appeals to the Nevada and United States Supreme Courts. Having served as the attorney for state and local political parties, Mr. Hardy has overseen, advised and litigated issues regarding elections, campaigns and voting rights. Beyond the courtroom, Mr. Hardy has obtained privileged and other licenses for firearms companies, restaurants, sports bars, gaming manufacturers, slot route operators and medical/recreational marijuana establishments. He has also assisted clients in proposing and opposing legislation and controls which impact their business and trade associations and presenting policy and other arguments on behalf of clients before federal, state and local regulatory and professional agencies. Mr. Hardy served on the board of a number of organizations including Easter Seals Nevada and Roseman University. Beyond the office, Mr. Hardy enjoys spending time in the outdoors with his wife and four children.

attorneys.name: K. Ryan Helmick
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Ryan is a nationally recognized award-winning attorney who has handled some of the most high-profile cases in Las Vegas. He has been voted “Best Criminal Defense Attorney of Las Vegas” by the Las Vegas Review Journal as well as received the “Lawyer of the Year” award for 2024 and 2025. Ryan is the Founder and Lead Attorney of The Defense Firm and author of “The Defense Begins” located on Amazon.

Ryan was born in Elkins, West Virginia. Eventually, he spent his childhood living and growing up with his younger brother in both Las Vegas, NV and Cocoa Beach, FL as his parents lived on opposite coasts. He is a proud father of his daughter. His daughter was born with Cerebral Palsy and is his ultimate teacher and daily reminder of the importance of listening, engaging, and above all, having a patient and empathetic view on life. All of these are attributes Ryan uses every day in his practice.

He completed his Undergraduate Degree in Criminal Justice at The University of Nevada, Las Vegas. He then moved to San Diego, CA to go to Thomas Jefferson School of Law. During his time there, he made the Dean’s List for Academic Excellence.

His studies in law school focused on Criminal Law and Trial Practice. Every year, he does things to improve his ability as a lawyer and set himself apart from the rest, such as attending a legal seminar, lecture, or reading books. He has trained with the Trial Lawyers College, founded by the late famed trial lawyer Gerry Spence, on more than one occasion. Likewise, during most of his career, he had the very fortunate and great pleasure of being mentored by the legendary Las Vegas criminal defense lawyer, the late Bill Terry. Learning from these two Hall of Fame lawyers gave Ryan the tools necessary to provide the best defense possible for his clients.

Today, Ryan continues to practice exclusively in Criminal Defense. He is a member of the Office of Appointed Counsel for cases that involve life sentences. In addition, he serves as an Ombudsman for the Police Fatality Fact-Finding Review Board. He has also appeared on two episodes of the show on A&E called “The Accused: Guilty or Innocent,” specifically for his cases. Ryan and The Defense Firm have garnered numerous accolades and recognition within the law community, from being honored by prestigious organizations such as the National Trial Lawyers, Super Lawyers, the National Academy of Criminal Defense Attorneys, Lawyers of Distinction, as well as receiving client-choice awards for excellence in legal advocacy. Ryan’s dedication to the law has not gone unnoticed.

But Ryan will be the first to say that it’s not the awards that set him apart from the rest. What sets Ryan apart from many other criminal defense attorneys is his passion for what he does, his love for his clients, and his relentless preparation of the cases that he defends. “Walking out of the courtroom, knowing I did everything I could do for that person, knowing I gave it everything I had, that’s what it’s all about.”

attorneys.bio:
Ms. Higbee’s practice consists primarily of real estate matters including homeowners association matters, property management matters, transactions and litigation. She has provided advice to homeowners associations, commercial property owners associations, commercial landlord matters, property managers, lenders in connection with SBA loan closings, real estate agents and buyers and sellers of real estate. Clients turn to Ms. Higbee for her expertise in compliance with CC&Rs, Bylaws, Articles and other documents for common interest communities and commercial property owners associations, leasing matters, eviction matters, closing SBA loans, regulatory compliance and other real estate matters.

Ms. Higbee is a shareholder with the firm and began serving as president in January 2019. She has an AV Preeminent rating by Martindale-Hubbell, the highest possible peer rating for ethical standards and legal ability. Ms. Higbee has lectured for various organizations and has published materials concerning real estate matters, landlord/tenant law, community association matters and commercial association matters. Ms. Higbee serves on the Common-Interest Community Committee of the State Bar of Nevada, Real Property Section which purpose is to address proposed changes to legislation and existing statutes including NRS 116.

When Ms. Higbee is not working, she can be found boating, playing volleyball, traveling and spending time with her family.

attorneys.name: Garima Jain
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Garima Jain is a partner in Smith Jain where her practice focuses on divorce, child custody and visitation, Pre-Nuptial and Post Nuptial Agreements, domestic partnership dissolution, cohabitation disputes, mediation, paternity, termination of parental rights, and child support.

Admitted to the State Bar of Nevada in 2010, Garima received her Bachelor of Commerce Honors degree in Accounting from Jesus and Mary College, New Delhi, India, in 1999, and her law degree from The University of Richmond, T.C. Williams School of Law in Richmond, Virginia in 2009 where she graduated cum laude. She represented her law school in the world’s largest moot court competition, the Philip C. Jessup International Law Moot Court Competition. In law school, she also received the Cali Excellence for the Future Award in Family Law. She also completed law school from Bombay University, Government Law College in India in 2005 where she graduated magna cum laude.

Garima has a passion for family law and has worked in that field exclusively since becoming an attorney. She has litigated cases at trial level, successfully mediated several cases and appeared before the Nevada Supreme and Appellate courts.

Garima connects with her clients on a personal level, but always maintains a professional relationship. She represents every client with a strong sense of advocacy and integrity. She strives to resolve the cases as quickly, inexpensively and painlessly as reasonable under the unique circumstance of each case.

When not practicing law, Garima enjoys spending time with her family, traveling, hiking tall mountains, cooking and running. She is fluent in Hindi.

attorneys.name: Paul H. Janda Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Paul H. Janda, Esq., Wharton MBA, FAAN, is the only Board-Certified Neurologist, Certified Life Care Planner, and attorney with an MBA from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania, the world’s top business school. With unmatched expertise across medicine, law, and business, Attorney Janda offers clients a level of strategic advocacy and case understanding no other attorney in the United States can match.

Raised in a family of physicians in California, Attorney Janda completed undergraduate studies at Stanford University and the University of California, Berkeley, graduating with double majors in Molecular and Cell Biology and Psychology. He earned his medical degree from Touro University California, achieving Dean’s List honors, and then completed his Internal Medicine internship at Valley Hospital Medical Center in Las Vegas. His advanced neurology training includes fellowships at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and Wake Forest School of Medicine.

Determined to bridge law and medicine, Attorney Janda earned his Juris Doctor from the William S. Boyd School of Law at UNLV. He is licensed to practice law in Nevada, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and New York. As a practicing attorney and Certified Life Care Planner, he possesses the rare ability to fully calculate and prove the actual long-term impacts of catastrophic injuries — a capability no other lawyer nationwide can offer.

Attorney Janda’s legal success includes serving as the expert in the largest single-plaintiff verdict in Nevada history, securing a $160 million judgment. He has been repeatedly honored with Top Doctor and Top Lawyer awards and recognized by the New York Times, Wall Street Journal, and USA Today as one of the most influential figures in medicine and law.

At The Janda Law Firm, Attorney Janda aggressively represents clients in cases involving catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, car accidents, truck accidents, and complex personal injury claims. His unique background allows him to explain injuries more powerfully, calculate damages more precisely, and advocate more relentlessly than traditional attorneys.

Attorney Janda is also a practicing attorney. He and his wife, an aggressive attorney at The Janda Law Firm, advocate for clients facing the most serious legal challenges, combining deep medical knowledge with strategic legal advocacy to deliver outstanding results.

Born to immigrant parents and fluent in Spanish through his wife’s proud Hispanic heritage, Attorney Janda remains driven by service, compassion, and excellence. When your case demands more than just a lawyer, elite medical insight, legal expertise, and strategic precision, there is only one choice: Attorney Paul H. Janda, Esq, Wharton MBA, FAAN — a standard of excellence without equal.

attorneys.name: Collin M. Jayne
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Collin Jayne is an experienced civil litigation attorney who focuses on commercial litigation, real estate disputes, and construction law. He prides himself on providing full-service representation to a broad variety of clients all the way from prelitigation planning (and litigation avoidance) through prosecuting and defending claims at trial and on appeal.

Mr. Jayne represents business clients of all sizes and industries, assisting them in navigating complex disputes over contracts, business torts, shareholder/partnership disputes, and intellectual property disputes. In his real estate practice, Mr. Jayne has considerable experience representing landlords and property management companies on a broad scope of contractual disputes and title litigation, and he has assisted small business and individuals in smaller-scale real estate ownership and lease disputes. In the construction realm, Mr. Jayne brings a unique understanding of the construction process to assist clients in disputes over construction contracts, payment and mechanic’s lien disputes, and construction defect claims.

Over the past decade, Mr. Jayne has secured favorable outcomes for his clients in state and federal court proceedings, including numerous bench trials, jury trials, and appeals, as well as mediation and arbitration proceedings. In addition to his experience representing clients at Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Jayne draws from his experience from serving as a judicial law clerk to the Honorable Adriana Escobar in the Eighth Judicial District Court of Clark County Nevada, where he developed a sense for the judicial perspective on civil cases and honed his legal writing skills. During law school, Mr. Jayne had the honor of serving as the Executive Managing Editor of the Nevada Law Journal.

When not practicing law, Mr. Jayne spends his time with his wife and three kids, exploring complicated new board games, and drinking good coffee.

attorneys.name: Natalie E. Karacsonyi, Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Natalie El-Kouz Karacsonyi practices exclusively in the area of complex divorce and family law litigation. Natalie is a member of the State Bar of Nevada, including its Family Law Section. Natalie is also a member of both the American Bar Association and the Clark County Bar Association.

Natalie has been involved in the Las Vegas Family Law community for more than a decade. Prior to entering private practice, Natalie served as judicial law clerk to two (2) different Family Court Judges: The Honorable Gerald W. Hardcastle, and the Honorable T. Arthur Ritchie, Jr. – who was then serving as the Chief Judge of the Eighth Judicial District Court, Clark County, Nevada. Following her time with the Court, Natalie entered private practice and spent the next seven (7) years honing her skills litigating complex family law matters.

Natalie has also co-authored materials for multiple presentations in the area of family law, including, but not limited to, “Cohabitation Agreements: Purposes and Procedures” for the State Bar of Nevada Annual Meeting in 2011 (which materials were also used for the State Bar of Nevada Advanced Family Law Program in 2011), “The Great Debates,” a presentation on the topics of child support jurisdiction, unconscionability in premarital agreements, and the modification and merger of marital settlement agreements, for the State Bar of Nevada Advanced Family Law Program in 2012, and “Preparing Your Client for Deposition: Procedures, Advice and Dealing with the Uncomfortable Truth” for the State Bar of Nevada Advanced Family Law Program in 2013.

Natalie graduated, magna cum laude, from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, with her B.A. in Political Science, with an emphasis in the area of Public Law. She thereafter earned her J.D., cum laude, from the William S. Boyd School of Law, ranked in the top fifteen percent (15%) of her class. During law school, Natalie participated in a community service program whereby she assisted in providing pro bono classes to the public in the areas of paternity and custody.

Natalie continues to devote time to providing pro bono legal services to those not otherwise able to afford legal representation, and has participated in the Partners in Pro Bono Project through the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada in both 2015 and 2016.

attorneys.name: Josef M. Karacsonyi, Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Josef M. Karacsonyi practices exclusively in the areas of family law, civil litigation, and personal injury litigation. Josef is a member of the State Bar of Nevada and the Florida Bar. He is also admitted to practice in the United States District Court for the District of Nevada.

Josef was elected to the Executive Council for the State Bar of Nevada Family Law Section, and has served on the Executive Council since 2011. Josef also served on the Advisory Council to the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada Pro Bono Project from 2012 to 2016. Josef's commitment to serving those in need was recognized with his receipt of the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada's Louis Wiener Pro Bono Service Award in 2014, and contributed to The Dickerson Karacsonyi Law Group receiving the Pro Bono Project Small Firm of the Year award in 2012. Josef also served as Co-Chair of the State Bar of Nevada Family Law Section's Child Witness Committee, and has contributed to and co-drafted Amicus Curiae briefs submitted by the Family Law Section to the Supreme Court of Nevada.

Josef frequently presents in the area of family law. Josef co-presented "Ethics and Very Hard Choices in Evidence" at the State Bar of Nevada's Annual Family Law Conference in 2012, and co-presented on the issue of civility at the same conference in 2013. Josef co-authored "Malpractice Traps When Preparing and Reviewing Prenuptial Agreements" for the State Bar of Nevada Advanced Family Law Program in 2011, and "The Great Debates," a presentation on the topics of child support jurisdiction, unconscionability in premarital agreements, and the modification and merger of marital settlement agreements, for the same program in 2012. In 2014, Josef assisted the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada in organizing a series of courses on the basics of family law, and co-presented the first part of the series on divorce process and procedure. In 2016, Josef assisted the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada in organizing, and moderated, "As Judges See It: Top Mistakes Attorneys Make in Family Court," a presentation and discussion with seven Family Court Judges from the Eighth Judicial District Court, Clark County, Nevada.

Prior to entering private practice, Josef served as judicial law clerk to the Honorable T. Arthur Ritchie, Jr. during Judge Ritchie's tenure as Presiding Judge of the Eighth Judicial District Court, Family Division.

Josef received his B.A. in Political Science from the University of Southern California in 2003, and earned his J.D., cum laude, from the University of Miami School of Law in 2006. During law school, Josef was a member and editor of the University of Miami Inter-American Law Review, and received awards for the highest grade in Legal Research and Writing, Legislation, Civil Procedure II, and Trusts and Estates.

In his more than 13 years of practice, Mr. Katz has counseled his clients in the areas of Federal and State Income and Estate Taxation; State and Local Real Property Taxation; Estate Planning, Probate, and Trust Administration; Business Organizations and Business Transactions; Real Estate, and Health Care Transactions. Mr. Katz has handled several disputes before the IRS and the Nevada Department of Taxation. Mr. Katz has lectured at several continuing education seminars on business organizations, business transactions, and tax issues, including, income and real property tax issues, §1031 like-kind exchange issues, partnership taxation, and taxation of S Corporations. Mr. Katz co-authored one of the first articles on the "Spendthrift Trust Act of Nevada" following the enactment of amendments to it that now allow clients to create Nevada Asset Protection Trusts. Mr. Katz earned his B.S. in Accounting from the University of Nevada at Las Vegas in May, 1994; his J.D. (cum laude) from Suffolk University Law School, Boston, MA in May 1997; and his LL.M. (taxation) from Boston University School of Law in May 1998. While at Suffolk Law School, Mr. Katz served as Research Assistant to Professor Russell Murphy during the 1995-1996 academic year. Mr. Katz is admitted to the State Bar of Nevada, and is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada and the U.S. Tax Court.

attorneys.name: Cedric A Kerns
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Cedric A. Kerns came to Las Vegas in 1985 to attend the University of Nevada, Las Vegas where he was a member of the nationally ranked debate team before graduating in 1989. He received his juris doctorate in 1992 from the University of San Diego.

Cedric was a partner and co-founder of the law office of Kerns and Lybarger, where he focused on criminal defense and domestic law. While in private practice, he was appointed as a member of the Nevada Supreme Court Task Force for the "Study of Economic Bias in the Justice System".

Cedric was elected to department 5 of the Las Vegas Municipal Court in 1997 at the age of 31, making him the youngest judge on the bench in the State of Nevada. While on the bench he received numerous recognitions for the work that he did within the community of Las Vegas. Some of the highlighted awards include being chosen "Judge of the Year" in 2006 by the Nevada Judges Association. The Foundation for Recovery recognized him by presenting him with the "Community Partner Award" for the year of 2009. Community Counseling Center recognized him with his outside the box thinking, by presenting him with the 2013 "Vision Award." He was also recognized by the Nevada Supreme Court in 2013 by being the first limited jurisdiction judge to receive the "Legacy of Justice Award", this award is presented to a person within the judiciary whose career has resulted in significant and innovation improvements in the justice system to the benefit of the citizens of Nevada. In 2016, he was the recipient of the Foundation for Recovery's "Brick Award", the highest honor bestowed by the foundation. During his tenure on the bench, he was recognized on three different occasions by the Mayor and City Council with a "Judge Cedric A. Kerns Day". He has also presented at numerous State Judicial Conferences, National Conferences and has presented at the National Judicial College.

After serving 27 years on the bench he retired and joined the firm of Watkins & Letofsky, LLP. He is now a partner in the Nevada office of Watkins, Letofsky & Kerns, LLP., practicing primarily in criminal defense and insurance subrogation.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Nevada Judges Association "Judge of the year", 2006 - Present

Nevada Supreme Court "Legacy of Justice Award", 2013 - Present

Foundation for Recovery "Brick Award", 2016 - Present

attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Clara Kim is an associate litigation attorney at Michaelson Law, dedicated to providing strategic and client-focused legal counsel.

She brings a diverse professional background that has shaped her ability to navigate complex legal matters with diligence and care.

Originally from Los Angeles, California, Clara earned her undergraduate degree in History from the University of California, Los Angeles. Before pursuing a career in law, she gained valuable experience in various industries, including education and business. She spent a year teaching English in Osaka, Japan, where she honed her communication skills and developed a deep appreciation for working with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds. Upon returning to the U.S., she transitioned into sales and marketing, gaining hands-on experience in negotiation, client relations, and business development.

Driven by a desire to serve her community and advocate for others, Clara ultimately pursued a legal career, moving to Las Vegas in 2021 to earn her law degree from the William S. Boyd School of Law. Her multidisciplinary background allows her to approach legal issues with a well-rounded perspective, ensuring thoughtful and tailored solutions for her clients.

Clara is passionate about helping individuals and businesses navigate legal challenges with clarity and confidence. She is committed to building strong relationships with clients and providing guidance that aligns with their goals and needs.

Will Lemkul joined Morris, Sullivan & Lemkul® in February 2002 and became a shareholder of the firm in 2005. Prior to joining Morris, Sullivan & Lemkul®, Will worked with one of Nevada's most respected litigation firms: Kemp, Jones & Coulthard, LLP.

Today, Will represents individual and corporate clients in Nevada, California and Hawaii and practices in the areas of personal injury, catastrophic loss, wrongful death, trademark infringement as well as multi-district and complex civil litigation. Will has represented hundreds of clients in pharmaceutical drug injury cases ranging from Fen-Phen to Avandia. Will's clients are widely diverse, ranging from professional athletes to fortune 500 companies. Will has tried numerous cases to verdict obtaining millions of dollars in verdicts and settlements in everything from product defect claims, to trademark infringement disputes. From 2004 to 2013, Will handled litigated claims in excess of $200,000,000.00. Three (3) such lawsuits involved the successful defense of claims against celebrity Chef, Paula Deen; as well as Big Lots, and Walmart.

Will earned his Bachelor's Degree in 1994 at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas and obtained his Juris Doctorate Degree from California Western School of Law in San Diego in 1998. While at California Western, Will was a member of the school's Law Review and International Law Journal. In 1997, Will was awarded the American Jurisprudence award for trial practice. Will is rated as an AV® PreeminentTM lawyer by Martindale-Hubbell®, the highest rating a lawyer may achieve. Will is also a fellow of The Litigation Counsel of America. The Litigation Counsel of America is a trial lawyer honorary society composed of less than one-half of one percent of American lawyers.

In 2012, Will was nominated as a "Top Attorney" in the areas of Construction Defect and Intellectual Property by the San Diego Daily Transcript. Will was recognized as a "Top Attorney" by the San Diego Daily Transcript in both 2013 and 2014 in the area of construction defect litigation. Will was one of only ten (10) attorneys in San Diego to receive such distinction. Since 2014, San Diego Magazine has recognized Will as one of San Diego's "Best In the City" in the area of Civil Litigation.

Will is currently a member of the State Bar of California; State Bar of Nevada; American Bar Association; and Clark County Bar Association. Will is licensed to practice in Nevada, California and Hawaii, including all Nevada, California and Hawaii federal courts and he is active in numerous community and civic organizations.

attorneys.practice_type: Litigation—Commercial & Complex Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Levins, a third-generation Nevadan, graduated from the William S. Boyd School of Law in Las Vegas, where he was a member of the Society of Advocates moot court team. In addition to graduating with Pro Bono Honors and receiving an award for Outstanding Student of the Semester for Boyd's Community Service Program, Mr. Levins served as a student attorney with the Education Advocacy Clinic for two semesters, advocating for parents and children with special needs in educational issues, including special education and disciplinary issues. Prior to law school, Mr. Levins attended the George Washington University, where he received his B.A. in International Affairs with a concentration in security studies and a minor in Russian Language and Literature.

Before joining Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Levins worked as a practicing attorney at a well-known nationwide firm, where he was exposed to a wide range of practice areas, including complex commercial litigation and construction litigation.

When not practicing law, Mr. Levins enjoys cooking, spending time with his family, and cheering on the Golden Knights.

Additionally, Ms. Lloyd externed for the Honorable Mark R. Denton of the Eighth Judicial District Court.

attorneys.name: Michele T. LoBello Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Michele T. LoBello is a founding partner of Black & LoBello. Practicing exclusively in the area of family law, Ms. LoBello handles all domestic matters, including divorce and post-divorce mediation and litigation, paternity, child custody, adoption, termination of parental rights, guardianship, prenuptial and cohabitation agreements, and juvenile dependency.

Ms. LoBello received her bachelor’s degree from Arizona State University after serving as intern to the Honorable John McCain. Upon obtaining her Juris Doctor from Creighton University School of Law, Ms. LoBello served as law clerk to the Honorable Steven Jones, Eighth Judicial District Court Judge, Family Division.

Ms. LoBello was admitted to practice with the State Bar of Nevada in 1994, and has practiced family law exclusively ever since. She has practiced before the State and Supreme Courts of Nevada, as well as before the United States District Court, District of Nevada, and the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.

Ms. LoBello is a member of Nevada State Bar Association, Clark County Bar Association and the American Trial Lawyers Association. She has served as a Court Appointed Special Advocate, and is active in the Clark County Pro Bono Project. In addition, she has been noted in Who’s Who Among American Lawyers, Super Lawyers, and is an AV® Preeminent rated attorney amongst peer reviews, the highest level of professional excellence.

attorneys.name: Kate Ludwick
attorneys.practice_type: Probate Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Kate Ludwick is an associate attorney at Michaelson Law, specializing in probate and guardianship matters. She assists individuals and families with estate administration, guardianship proceedings, and related legal issues, ensuring a smooth and effective process for her clients.

A native of Carson City, Nevada, Kate earned her undergraduate degree from Rutgers University. Before pursuing law, she gained experience in various industries and briefly worked as a lobbyist at the Nevada Legislature with a local church group. This role provided her with valuable insight into legislative processes and strengthened her decision to attend law school. She later relocated to Las Vegas to earn her law degree from the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.

Since becoming licensed to practice law in 2021, Kate has focused on probate and guardianship, guiding clients through estate settlements, guardianship appointments, and related legal processes. She takes a client-focused approach, offering clear guidance and practical solutions tailored to each family’s unique circumstances.

attorneys.bio:
About Brian

As a member of the litigation team at Edward M. Bernstein & Associates, Brian recognizes the importance of representing the injured and disabled members of the community and ensuring that they are fairly compensated for their injuries.

Brian joined Edward M Bernstein and Associates in 2017. Licensed to practice law in Nevada since 2008, Brian has gained extensive experience in handling personal injury cases and social security disability claims in State and Federal Court.

His years of experience and his personable demeanor make him a caring yet effective advocate and enables him to maximize the compensation for his clients while seeing to their individual needs.

Brian was born in Mesa, Arizona, and received his Bachelor of Science degree in Political Science from the University of Utah. He attended Florida Coastal School of Law where he received his Juris Doctor degree and was a member of the mock trial team.

Brian enjoys cycling, watching football and spending time with his wife and their four children.

Brian's Achievements

attorneys.name: Martin Manke
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Martin Manke is the managing attorney at Michaelson Law, bringing over 25 years of experience in high-end litigation matters. Known for his strategic approach and commitment to excellence, Martin has earned the prestigious Martindale-Hubbell AV Preeminent rating, a distinction he has held for over a decade.

Martin represents individuals and businesses in various complex legal matters, including contractual disputes, general liability issues, probate and guardianship matters, and contested trust and estate cases. Before joining Michaelson Law, he was a partner at one of the largest national law firms, where he honed his expertise in high-stakes litigation.

Martin attended law school at California Western School of Law and was admitted to the State Bar of Nevada in 1999. He is now a mentor to first-year attorneys for the Bar.

Martin is a proud Las Vegas native. He graduated from UNLV with a bachelor’s degree in history in 1996. While in college, Martin served as a Student Ambassador and interned for former U.S. Senator, Harry Reid, in Washington, D.C.

Outside of his legal practice, Martin enjoys spending time with his two children, tackling home improvement projects, exploring Lake Mead, and adventuring in his side-by-side.

Albert G. Marquis (now retired) founding partner of Marquis Aurbach, practiced law in Las Vegas for over 40 years. He began his career as a trial lawyer, with some cases involving high-profile celebrities such as Redd Foxx and Martin Sheen. In 1983, he recovered $1.2 million against Aetna Casualty, including the highest emotional distress damage award in Nevada history. Over the years, he was responsible for several precedent-setting cases in the Nevada Supreme Court. Mr. Marquis was rated “AV” by Martindale-Hubbell‒the highest rating possible. attorneys.name: Scott A. Marquis
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Scott Marquis is a shareholder with the firm. He has an AV Preeminent® rating by Martindale-Hubbell®, the highest possible peer rating for ethical standards and legal ability. Mr. Marquis was also recently recognized for Lifetime Achievement by his selection to America's Top 100 Attorneys® (2016) - an award limited to only 100 attorneys in each State who have displayed a lifetime of hard work, ethical standards, and community enriching accomplishments. Finally, Mr. Marquis has been distinguished as a Mountain States Super Lawyers (2015-2025), and as one of the Top Lawyers by Vegas Inc. Magazine (2013).

Mr. Marquis has lived in the Las Vegas Valley since 1975, and has been practicing law since 1997 when he joined MAC. Mr. Marquis' primary practice areas are in real estate, business, and commercial landlord-tenant fields, but he does not represent residential tenants. During that time, Mr. Marquis has had the pleasure of representing some of the Valley's most prominent organizations, including the following: Jake's Crane, Lift Equipment Certification Company, FirstMed Health and Wellness Center, Boulder City Hospital, Sunshine Minting Inc., Las Vegas Billboards, Aura Outdoor, LLC, Keller Williams The Marketplace, Powerhouse Platinum, Aura Outdoor, Building Hope Nevada, Wynn Las Vegas, the Henderson Saddle Association, RL Homes, Accessible Space, Inc., the Greater Las Vegas Association of REALTORS®, the Southern Nevada Workforce Investment Board (aka workforceCONNECTIONS), The State Police Officers Council, the Southern Nevada Regional Housing Authority.

Mr. Marquis strongly believes that his first priority is to keep his clients out of court by providing sound legal advice and well written agreements that greatly reduce his clients' potential liabilities. Nevertheless, once all other reasonable options have been exhausted, Mr. Marquis has also proven to be a very successful litigator. For example, he represented clients against local housing developer, James Rhodes, and came away with a judgment in his clients' favor and a payment from Rhodes of over $3.5 million.

Mr. Marquis has significant experience in real estate and development matters in both the litigation and transactional context. He recently represented the Boulder City Hospital (a non-profit entity), in its $16 million expansion project. Previously, he represented the Housing Authority of the City of Las Vegas in several multi-million dollar developments, and has represented other businesses, developers, real estate owners, and contractors involved in real estate, construction and business transactions in Clark County.

In addition, Mr. Marquis gained much of his real estate experience while representing the Greater Las Vegas Association of REALTORS® for over 10 years, during which time he had the opportunity to advise the Association's Professional Standards Panels in over a hundred different REALTOR® ethics and arbitration hearings. Mr. Marquis also has significant experience in administrative law proceedings, as he has successfully represented clients before the Nevada Contractor's Board, the Nevada Real Estate Commission and the Nevada Ethic's Commission. Further, Mr. Marquis has significant experience in several other areas of the law, including those laws that control quasi municipal entities and political officials such as the Nevada Open Meeting Law (NRS Chapter 241) and the Ethics in Government Law (NRS 281A and NAC 281A). Indeed, while representing the local housing authorities, Mr. Marquis advised their Boards of Commissioners in well over 100 special and regular meetings.

attorneys.name: Leah Martin
attorneys.practice_type: Business Organizations Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
In 1999, Leah graduated summa cum laude from UNLV with a Bachelor of Arts degree in Environmental Studies and Political Science. In law school, she was Editor-in-Chief of the Nevada Law Journal and judicial extern to United States District Court Judge Phillip Pro. She graduated summa cum laude from UNLV's law school in 2002. At graduation, she was recognized as the William S. Boyd Outstanding Graduate.

Following her graduation from law school, she immediately began employment at Lionel Sawyer & Collins, at the time the largest law firm in the state, which specializes in a variety of business matters. While at that firm, and subsequently at Bailey Kennedy, she gained experience on complex matters while being mentored by a variety of top professionals in Nevada.

In 2011, she made the choice to establish her own firm. She brings to her firm many years of experience in all areas of business law, including preparing formation documents; drafting operating and shareholder agreements, partnership agreements, purchase and finance agreements, leases, surrender agreements, non-compete and non-disclosure agreements, and employment agreements; contract litigation; shareholder derivative suits; business dissolutions; and appellate matters.

During the course of her practice of law, she has also been involved in many areas of legal education and service. She was an associate editor of the Nevada Civil Practice Manual from 2004-2010. She was a teaching assistant for the Nevada Civil Practice class at UNLV's law school from 2006-2008. She has been a grader for the Nevada Bar Exam since 2008. She has chaired the Clark County Law Foundation Community Service Committee, having served on the committee since 2007. In addition to maintaining her own cases, she has also been an arbitrator on the Court Annexed Arbitration Program Panel since 2012.

She is currently licensed with the State Bars of Nevada and Arizona. She is also certified to practice Law in the United States District Court for the District of Nevada and the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. She is a member of the American Bar Association, State Bar of Nevada, Clark County Bar Association, and Southern Nevada Association of Women Attorneys.

She currently lives with her husband Scot and two daughters. She is involved in numerous community organizations, including UNLV Alumni Association (lifetime member), Sigma Kappa Sorority Alumni Association, CARE Complex Board of Director, Commercial Real Estate Women, National Association of Women Business Owners, and Leadership Henderson Class of 2017 Alumni.

Leah has continued to achieve her success and goals while being the managing partner of her own law firm.

attorneys.name: Tye D. Masters Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: Benson & Bingham Accident Injury Lawyers, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Tye Masters graduated cum laude from the University of Southern California in 2013 with dual majors in Political Science and Philosophy, Politics, and Law, along with a minor in Business Law. He then returned to his hometown of Las Vegas and earned his law degree from the UNLV William S. Boyd School of Law as a Dean’s Merit Scholarship recipient in 2017. After passing the bar on his first attempt, he served as in-house counsel for University Medical Center of Southern Nevada, where he handled complex regulatory matters involving Medicare, Medicaid, insurance billing, and hospital accreditation. He also litigated claims related to medical malpractice, premises liability, physician credentialing, and patient accounting disputes. In 2025, Tye joined Benson & Bingham, bringing his extensive legal expertise to advocate for personal injury clients and maximize their recoveries.

As the son of a U.S. Air Force pilot, Tye grew up in diverse environments, including Germany, Texas, and Arkansas, before settling in Southern Nevada in 2001. He proudly calls Nevada home and is committed to passionately representing his clients while serving his community. Outside of his legal practice, Tye enjoys attending Vegas Golden Knights games, cheering on the USC Trojans, golfing, and taking afternoon walks with his two dogs.

attorneys.name: Vincent Mayo
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce and Family Law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Vincent Mayo is certified by the State Bar of Nevada as a family law specialist and is a partner at The Abrams Law Firm LLC. Attorney Mayo is also a Martindale-Hubbell AV Rated preeminent attorney. This distinction is achieved by only a small fraction of licensed attorneys worldwide.

Mr. Mayo is Board Certified in Family Law by the American Bar Association accredited National Board of Trial Advocacy, a division of the National Board of Legal Specialty Certification. He is one of only seventeen Las Vegas divorce attorneys to receive this distinction. He has also successfully completed the ABA's Family Law Trial Advocacy Institute program, which accepts only 50 applications nationally each year.

Vincent Mayo began his legal career in Nevada working in the Clark County Family Courts system. He worked directly for Clark County Family Court Judge Gloria Sanchez as a Law Clerk, from September of 2002 to March 2004. Before joining The Abrams Law Firm, he practiced for four years, primarily in Family Law, for a prestigious local law firm.

Attorney Mayo has been selected to be the co-editor of the Nevada Family Law Practice Manual. This manual is used by all family law attorneys and judges in Nevada as the foremost compilation of Nevada statutes, case law, and local and state rules. He is a well published attorney with numerous credits including:

Recognition and Enforcement of Due Process Rights in Family Court Criminal Contempt Proceedings (Nevada Family Law Report Fall 2017)

Have the Interests of Parents Been Placed at Odds With Those of Their Kidnapped Children? (Nevada Family Law Report Summer 2015)

Better Your Odds: Knowing the Factors that Affect the Recovery of Marital Assets Wasted Through Gambling (Nevada Lawyer Magazine Fall 2006)

A Closer Look at the Uniform Child Witness by Alternative Methods Act (*Communique June / July 2007)

Three Common Approaches for Determining What Constitutes Legitimate Business Expenses for Child Support Purposes (*Communique June / July 2007)

Las Vegas Divorce Matters and Revocable Family Trusts (Nevada Family Law Report - Winter 2013)

Attorney Mayo is a member of good standing of the State Bar of Nevada, State Bar of Nevada Family Law Section, American Bar Association, Nevada Justice Association, and Clark County Bar Association. He also has been accepted as an American Bar Association Panelist. Vincent Mayo is admitted to practice before The United States District Court for the District of Nevada.

He received his Juris Doctorate degree from the University of Dayton School of Law. Attorney Mayo served as associate editor of the law school's Law Review, was elected to the Moot Court Litigation team, earned a Dean's Award Scholarship, achieved Dean's List Honors, and simultaneously worked as a Law Clerk for a Fortune 500 company while earning his law degree.

attorneys.name: Michael J. Miceli
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Michael Miceli moved with his family from New Jersey to Las Vegas in 1984. A graduate of Valley High School, Michael also achieved success at the Honors College of UNLV, where he graduated Cum Laude with a major in Criminal Justice and a minor in Political Science, and at the UNLV Boyd School of Law where he received his law degree.

In law school, Michael was an extern for Justice Michael Cherry, who later served as a member of the Nevada Supreme Court. Michael was also a law clerk at the Federal Public Defender’s Office and has extensive experience writing briefs in the Federal District Court of Nevada and in the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals. Michael is licensed to practice in all Nevada courts including the Federal District Court of Nevada.

The protégé of Mr. Pitaro, Michael was hand-selected by Mr. Pitaro to join his firm directly after being admitted to the Nevada Bar in 2006. Based on his exemplary trial skills while studying Trial Advocacy under Mr. Pitaro at the the Boyd School of Law, Mr. Pitaro knew Michael would make an outstanding addition to Pitaro & Fumo.

Michael has tried numerous jury trials to verdict as well as filed appeals to the Nevada Supreme Court. His tenacity in court is well-known and he is one of the most successful criminal defense attorneys in the State of Nevada.

attorneys.name: John P. Michaelson
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
John graduated from Utah State University with a Bachelor of Science in Business Finance in 1996. Before receiving his Law Degree from the University of Utah in 2001, he worked for over two years as a securities broker for Fidelity Investments with trading experience in stocks, bonds, mutual funds and options. While attending law school, John was a senior staff member of the Utah Law Review and co-founder of Law Students for Children, an advocacy organization for abused, neglected, and underprivileged children. He has continued his advocacy for the youth by being an active "Scouter" in the Boy Scouts of America and by maintaining his pledge as an Eagle Scout to serve the community, both young and old. Following his admission to the Nevada Bar in 2001, John served as a law clerk to the Honorable Robert J. Johnston, United States District Court for the District of Nevada. In 2002, John took a position as an associate for the prestigious law firm Piper Rudnick LLP, where he specialized in labor and employment litigation, primarily in federal court. John is a frequent lecturer at seminars and workshops on business and estate planning, asset protection, trust administration, probate and guardianships. John is a member of Wealth Counsel, LLC, and a founding member of the Wealth Counsel Advisors Forum, both national organizations dedicated to promoting the highest level of professionalism and expertise among business and estate planning professionals. Beginning next month, John will chair the Elder Law Section of the Nevada State Bar. John and his wife, Regina, are the parents of three children.

attorneys.name: Paul Michaelson
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Paul R. Michaelson is an accomplished attorney with over four decades of experience in estate planning, real estate law, and corporate law, including mergers and acquisitions. He founded Michaelson Law in 1992 to provide tailored legal solutions to individuals and businesses, building on his extensive knowledge and dedication to excellence.

His deep understanding of business and estate law is complemented by his expertise in securities law, gained during nearly five years as Director of Securities Registration & Licensing for the Nevada Securities Division (1987–1992). While at the Division, Paul played a key role in drafting the Nevada Administrative Code on securities laws and regulating investment activity in the state. His leadership extended to national efforts, where he served on committees with the North American Securities Administrators Association (NASAA) and contributed to the development of the Small Corporate Offering Registration (SCOR) program to support small business capital formation.

A frequent lecturer, he has presented at numerous seminars on capital formation, corporate law, and estate planning. Paul also served as Co-Chairman of the Advisory Committee to the UNLV Small Business Development Center and is currently the President of Friends in the Desert, a nonprofit dedicated to feeding the homeless.

Paul is a U.S. Army veteran, having served as a Captain in the Medical Service Corps. He was twice awarded the Army Commendation Medal for meritorious service.

Paul and his wife, Anne, have been happily married for over 50 years. Together, they have six children and are proud grandparents to 30 grandchildren.

attorneys.name: Jennifer L. Micheli
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Jennifer Micheli is an experienced litigator who has represented clients in numerous industries on a wide array of legal matters. She practices business law and complex civil litigation with a concentration on torts and products liability, premise liability, catastrophic injury, insurance defense and insurance law. Ms. Micheli is a tenacious litigator known for her strategic thinking, attention to detail, and unwavering dedication to achieving the best possible results for her clients.

Prior to joining Marquis Aurbach, Ms. Micheli was a shareholder as a regional Las Vegas based law-firm where she managed issues related to contracts, business entities, sports and entertainment, real estate, product liability and employment law. She also gained a broad range of experience during her career as in-house legal counsel for an international insurance company. As a staff-counsel attorney, Ms. Micheli represented insureds in third party personal injury and wrongful death cases and first party cases involving personal injury and bad faith allegations. Ms. Micheli has served as primary trial counsel and obtained favorable verdicts in jury trials in both State and Federal Courts in Nevada. During the course of her career, Ms. Micheli has also represented professionals in malpractice cases and civil conspiracy RICO actions.

Ms. Micheli received her Bachelor of Arts degree in Political Science, summa cum laude, in 2005 from Syracuse University in upstate New York. Thereafter, she returned to her hometown of Las Vegas, Nevada where she attended the University of Nevada, Las Vegas' William S. Boyd School of Law and graduated cum laude with her Juris Doctorate in 2008. During law school, Ms. Micheli served as an extern to the Honorable Judge Joseph T. Bonaventure, Sr. of the Eighth Judicial District Court, the Honorable Judge Nancy C. Oesterle of the Las Vegas Justice Court, and the Clark County Public Defender's Office.

attorneys.name: Tekla Modebadze
attorneys.practice_type: Tax Law Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Tekla Modebadze is an internationally trained attorney focused on U.S. tax controversy, white collar defense, and strategic cross-border tax planning. With a practice grounded in both technical precision and practical advocacy, she advises clients at the intersection of tax law, regulatory enforcement, and international compliance.

Tekla has extensive experience representing individuals and businesses before the Internal Revenue Service in all phases of audit, administrative appeals, and collection proceedings. She routinely handles matters involving IRS Criminal Investigations, Department of Justice prosecutions, and U.S. Tax Court litigation. Her background includes complex cases involving expatriation, FBAR enforcement, and multi-jurisdictional tax exposure.

Her deep understanding of the Internal Revenue Code, international tax reporting regimes, and federal criminal procedure enables her to manage sensitive tax disputes with accuracy, discretion, and strategic foresight. Known for her detail-driven approach and global perspective, Tekla works closely with clients navigating high-stakes tax and regulatory challenges in both domestic and international contexts.

Practice Areas Include:

Federal Tax Controversy & Litigation

IRS audit representation (examinations, appeals, and U.S. Tax Court)

IRS Appeals & Protest Letters

U.S. Tax Court petitions and litigation

Installment Agreements and Penalty Abatement

Innocent Spouse Relief petitions

IRS Passport Revocation defense

EFIN Revocation proceedings and federal complaints

White Collar & Criminal Tax Defense

IRS Criminal Investigations and pre-indictment strategy

Defense in federal tax crime prosecutions

Defense of Tax Return Preparers in civil and criminal matters

Tax Compliance & International Reporting

Foreign Tax Credit audits and compliance

Offshore Voluntary Disclosure guidance

Expatriation tax and compliance counseling

Strategic Tax Planning & Advisory

Tax planning

Start-up tax strategy and entity structuring

Nonprofit formation and tax-exempt status compliance

Kegan is married and has three children. When not working with and advocating for his clients, Kegan enjoys spending time with his family and wrenching on motorcycles and automobiles.
