attorneys.name: Jordan W. Montet
attorneys.practice_type: Appeals Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Jordan Montet is an experienced litigator who has represented clients in numerous industries on a wide array of legal matters. Ms. Montet focuses her practice on civil litigation, with an emphasis in healthcare law, specifically serving healthcare entities. In addition to working on civil litigation matters, Ms. Montet regularly represents professionals before their respective licensing boards.

Before joining Marquis Aurbach, Ms. Montet worked as a practicing attorney handling a wide range of professional liability, personal injury, general liability, and labor and employment matters. Ms. Montet is experienced assisting companies in the defense of employment discrimination, wage-and-hour class actions, contract disputes, and various tort claims.

Ms. Montet graduated from Auburn University, magna cum laude, with both a Bachelor of Arts degree in Spanish and Bachelor of Arts degree in Sociology in 2012. She received her Juris Doctorate in 2016 from Georgia State University School of Law in Atlanta, Georgia, where she graduated cum laude, with a certificate from the Center for Health, Law, and Society specializing in Health Law. While in law school, Jordan served two years as a graduate research assistant and completed a judicial clerkship with Presiding Justice P. Harris Hines of the Georgia Supreme Court. After obtaining her juris doctor, she was admitted to the State Bar of Georgia in October 2016. Jordan relocated to Las Vegas, Nevada in the Fall of 2017 and was admitted to the State Bar of Nevada in May 2018. Jordan is admitted to practice before all Nevada state courts, Georgia state courts, the U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada, and the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia.

In her spare time, Ms. Montet can be found cheering on the Auburn Tigers with her two dogs.

attorneys.name: Terry A. Moore
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Terry A. Moore is a native of Las Vegas and attended the University of Nevada, Las Vegas where he obtained his bachelor’s degree with honors in environmental studies in 1998. He then obtained his Juris Doctorate as a member of the charter class of the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2001.

Mr. Moore’s practice is primarily devoted to real estate matters with a particular emphasis on commercial real estate, landlord-tenant issues, title insurance and escrow litigation. Since 2001, Mr. Moore has represented numerous commercial and residential property management companies, commercial building owners, title insurers and title agents throughout Nevada. Mr. Moore has achieved an AV® Preeminent™ rating (the highest available) from Martindale-Hubbell and a “Top Attorney” rating from AVVO. He has also been voted by his peers as one of the Legal Elite in Southern Nevada and is recognized on the Mountain States Super Lawyers list. He has conducted numerous jury and bench trials before Nevada State and Federal Courts. He has also handled numerous appellate matters to the Nevada Supreme Court. Among his notable cases, Mr. Moore was co-lead trial and appellate counsel in the case of Thitchener v. Countrywide Home Loans, 192 P.3d 243 (Nev. 2008) (en banc).

Mr. Moore has been a member of the State Bar of Nevada Bar and the United States District Court, District of Nevada since 2001. In 2013, Mr. Moore was admitted to the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals and the United States Supreme Court. He is a member of the Nevada Land Title Association, Southern Nevada Escrow Association, Nevada Escrow Association, the American Escrow Association, the Nevada Apartment Association, and the Building Owners and Managers Association.

In his spare time Mr. Moore is an aspiring chef and wine enthusiast who enjoys watching football and soccer. He also enjoys spending time with his three children Jesse, Zachary, Madeleine and his wife Stacey.

attorneys.name: Monte J. Morris
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Monte J. Morris has practiced law in Nevada for 45 years and practices primarily in the areas of estate planning, probate, family law, criminal defense, administrative law, landlord/tenant, civil litigation and appellate law.

Mr. Morris was awarded his J.D. from the University of Utah in 1964 and is licensed in Nevada and Utah. Between 1965 and 1976, Monte served as a Deputy District Attorney for Clark County and as City Attorney for the City of Henderson and Boulder City. Thereafter, he pursued private practice as a trial attorney until 2000.

Mr. Morris has practiced extensively in all courts in the State, including numerous appearances before the Nevada Supreme Court and Federal Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. In 2000, he and his wife, Madeline, took leave to serve a Humanitarian Mission in Indonesia where he taught English at Pacuan University and lectured by invitation on American Jurisprudence to the Indonesian Supreme Court.

Monte has been active in the Boy Scouts of America. The Morrises reside in Boulder City and are the proud parents of eight and grandparents of thirty-two and counting.

attorneys.name: Jared M. Moser
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Jared M. Moser, Esq., practices in the areas of commercial litigation and contract disputes, employer defense, and landlord/tenant disputes, representing both individuals and businesses, large and small, in southern and northern Nevada.

Mr. Moser received his B.S.B.A. with a double major in marketing and business management from Hawai`i Pacific University. He returned to Nevada to obtain his Juris Doctorate from the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada – Las Vegas, during which time he represented family law clients as a Certified Student Attorney, was recognized with the CALI Excellence for the Future Award in International Human Rights, and was also awarded as a member of the Society of Advocates for Second Best Brief in the Jerome Prince Evidence Law Moot Court Competition.

Before joining Marquis Aurbach, Mr. Moser gained invaluable experience as an extern to the Honorable James T. Russell in the First Judicial District Court of Nevada, as a law clerk to the Honorable Nancy L. Allf in the Eighth Judicial District Court of Nevada, and as a law clerk for the Honorable Johnnie B. Rawlinson of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. He has authored numerous articles addressing a variety of legal issues topics for the American Inns of Court publication, The Bencher, and in the Infinity Business Magazine, and has appeared as a guest on the Su Negocio En Nevada radio show. He has also served on the Board of Directors for a local non-profit organization that provides aftercare for women who are former victims of human trafficking and sexual exploitation.

Mr. Moser is a member of the Howard D. McKibben Chapter of the American Inns of Court and is an alumni member and former officer of the Phi Alpha Delta Legal Fraternity International.

During his time out of the office, Mr. Moser enjoys time with his wife, Tara, and their two sons. When he and his family are not outdoors, Mr. Moser enjoys watching both college and professional football and basketball.

However, his passion for law led him back to UNLV, where he earned his Juris Doctorate from the William S. Boyd School of Law. Despite working full-time during the day, Brian managed to attend law school in the evenings, proving his dedication to his career.

Passions: When Brian isn't practicing Social Security Disability law, he indulges in his hobbies. He's an avid book collector, constantly adding to his ever-expanding library. You'll often find him immersed in a good read, striving to keep his pile of unread books manageable. Additionally, Brian makes time for local events like the Renaissance Faire, where he enjoys sharing his knowledge of the golden age of piracy with children.

attorneys.name: Cody S. Mounteer
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Contracting and Consulting/Risk Management Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Cody is a shareholder at Marquis Aurbach where he has successfully prosecuted and defended numerous complex litigation matters while representing a number of the nation’s largest builders and owners of properties that experience construction defects. Cody has extensive background and hands on experience in the construction industry. As a former project foreman on multiple private and government commercial and residential projects, he is uniquely qualified to identify and resolve issues from planning to ribbon cutting that present themself throughout the construction process. Along with Cody’s passion and extensive experience in the construction field, he has also concentrated a significant portion of his practice in the areas of oversight, risk management, lien recovery, and insurance coverage issues that relate to the fields of construction, real estate, and business law.

While in practice, Cody has been afforded the opportunity to represent clients ranging from private and publicly held corporations, to municipal clients involved in highly sensitive and publicized cases. Cody’s practice of law has brought him experience in a variety of high value and complex matters involving international, federal, state, and local laws and regulations.

Most recently, Cody was successful in acquiring a full defense verdict by jury trial for his client, an apartment complex owner, who faced a 21-million-dollar demand against it. Cody also was integral in settling various multi-million-dollar consolidated actions on behalf of an insurance carrier in receivership who wrote commercial general liability and workers compensation insurance for Nevada contractors. Further, Cody successfully defended and settled claims asserted against private and municipal entities with regard to the largest pipeline expansion project in the history of Clark County, Nevada.

When not practicing law, Mr. Mounteer can be found enjoying time with his family in the outdoors boating, hiking, skiing, or cruising on his motorcycle.

attorneys.name: John R. Mugan
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
John R. Mugan is an associate attorney at JEFFREY BURR. He graduated seventh in his class from Creighton University School of Law in Omaha, Nebraska in 1973 earning his Juris Doctor (J.D.) While attending law school John worked in the Clerk’s Office of the Douglas County, Nebraska, County Court (Probate Jurisdiction), Honorable Robert Troyer, Douglas County Judge.

John is an accomplished attorney with over thirty years of extensive estate planning and business law experience including estate and trust litigation, and has received the highest Martindale-Hubbell rating of AV by his peers. John has represented numerous individual and corporate fiduciaries, beneficiaries and litigants throughout his professional career. John is a frequent speaker on estate planning and estate/trust litigation to professional associations and institutions, and has testified as an expert witness.

John is Past President of the Siouxland Estate Planning Council and of the Woodbury County Bar Association, and is a member of the Southern Nevada Estate Planning Council, the Probate and Trust Sections of the Nevada State Bar Association and the Iowa State Bar Association, and the Nevada Justice Association. John’s civic and charitable associations include serving as past president of the local chapter of Rotary International and as a board member of the Siouxland Regional Cancer Center, Missouri River Historical Development, Sioux City Public Museum, Sioux City Lewis & Clark Interpretive Center and Heelan High School.

John is licensed to practice law in the states of Nevada, Iowa, Nebraska and South Dakota, and before the U.S. Supreme Court and the U.S. Tax Court.

attorneys.name: Tabetha J. Nakagawa
attorneys.practice_type: Corporate Law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Tabetha J. Nakagawa joined Marquis Aurbach as a law clerk in June 2022 and continued working as a law clerk up until she passed the bar, where she transitioned into becoming an attorney. Tabetha is a born and bred Las Vegas native who earned her bachelor’s degree in Public Relations and a minor in Consumer Behavior from the University of Southern California, where she graduated as Cum Laude. She then made her way back home, where she obtained her Juris Doctor degree from the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2023, where she also graduated as Cum Laude.

During law school, Tabetha received numerous recognitions and awards, including five CALI Excellence for the Future Awards in Contracts, Lawyering Process II (Legal Writing), Family Law, Community Property, and Antitrust. Additionally, Tabetha was named on the Dean’s List for three separate semesters, which included a semester where Tabetha was simultaneously working two jobs while she attended law school in the evenings. Before Tabetha joined Marquis Aurbach, she worked as a law clerk at a family law firm, while also managing the special events team at three popular casinos in Downtown Las Vegas. During that time, Tabetha was also awarded with the William S. Boyd Community Service Program Outstanding Student of the Semester in the Summer 2021 semester. In Tabetha’s final semester of law school, she was fortunate enough to extern with the Criminal Division of the Clark County District Attorney’s Office, where she was able to draft various pleadings, observe trials, and even practice in a limited capacity by giving oral arguments before the court under the Nevada Supreme Court Rule 49.3.

In Tabetha’s spare time, she loves going on foodie adventures, traveling, and attending live concerts and music festivals with her friends, family, and her better half Jon.

attorneys.name: Robert B. Noggle
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Robert B. Noggle began his career in private practice in Portland, Oregon. He transitioned to corporate practice serving as General Counsel for two different commercial asset-based lenders. Robert also worked to increase profitability for a privately held company that was first acquired by a subsidiary of the utility – Washington Water Power, and then by Textron Financial – a Fortune 500 company. He served as the company’s Chief Operating Officer. Since moving to Las Vegas in 1999, Robert has worked with several title companies and businesses involved with the real estate industry.

He is a frequent continuing education instructor for the real estate industry on the topics of Short Sales, Nevada Law & Legislation, and Internal Revenue Code 1031 Tax-Deferred Exchanges. He has also presented educational programs at the Lied Real Estate Institute, the Federation of Exchange Accommodators, to attorneys, and CPAs. Robert has also published a number of articles in various real estate industry publications.

A graduate of the University of Oregon, Mr. Noggle obtained his Juris Doctor from Lewis & Clark Law School in Portland. He was a staff member of Environmental Law Review and published a comment concerning an innovative municipal energy conservation ordinance. Mr. Noggle was admitted to practice law in the State of Oregon in 1980 and the State of Nevada in 2009.

attorneys.name: Daniel R. Ormsby
attorneys.practice_type: Probate Administration Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Daniel Ormsby is a Nevada-licensed attorney and a junior partner with Albright, Stoddard, Warnick & Albright. His practice focuses on civil litigation, business litigation, probate and trust administration, and probate and trust litigation. Daniel represents individuals, businesses, trustees, and beneficiaries in complex disputes and proceedings involving estates and trusts. He has significant trial and courtroom experience and regularly advocates for his clients in Nevada state courts.

Daniel was born in California and spent much of his childhood in Lindon, Utah. He graduated from Brigham Young University in 2013 with a Bachelor of Arts degree in Economics. He then attended the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, where he received a merit-based academic scholarship and earned his Juris Doctor in 2017.

During law school, Daniel interned for the Honorable Judge Kenneth Cory and worked as a law clerk for a firm specializing in estate and probate litigation. While at Boyd, he was a member of the Nevada Law Journal, a member of the Las Vegas Student Chapter of the J. Reuben Clark Law Society, and received a C.A.L.I. Award in Employment Discrimination.

Since becoming licensed to practice law in Nevada, Daniel has represented clients in a wide range of civil matters, including business disputes, probate and trust administration matters, and contested probate and trust litigation.

Daniel is married and the father of four children. Outside of his practice, he enjoys spending time with his family and traveling.

attorneys.name: Brian J. Pezzillo
attorneys.practice_type: Administrative Law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
My practice focuses on litigating, arbitrating and resolving claims arising from construction projects including the representation of clients in bankruptcy proceedings. This also involves counseling clients with regard to the drafting and negotiation of construction contracts. In addition I advise clients with regard to employment and labor issues. I represent clients before various administrative agencies and have represented clients before the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, the New Mexico Oil Conservation Commission, the Las Vegas Air Quality Commission and the Nevada State Contactor's Board.

I have previously served as an arbitrator with the Court-annexed arbitration program in the Eighth Judicial District Court, Clark County, Nevada.I have served as a Justice Pro Tem, Justice Court for Clark County, Nevada as well a Hearing Officer for Clark County. Additionally, I currently sit as an arbitrator for the Better Business Bureau of Nevada as well as a hearing officer for the City of Henderson, Nevada.

I am a frequent lecturer on topics relating to the construction industry, including payment issues, mechanic's lien claims, public contracting, and construction claims. I have been requested by both public and private entities to provide in-house lectures regarding the ever-changing Nevada construction laws.

I have served on the Government Affairs Committee of the National Association of Industrial and Office Properties and the Clark County Bar Continuing Education Committee. I am a member of the American Bar Association's Construction Industry Forum and Public Contracts Section. I am admitted to practice before all state and federal courts in the states of Nevada and New Mexico and before the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeal.

Awards and Honors

Honors

attorneys.firm_name: Marta L. Presti, Attorney at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Reno, NV
attorneys.bio:
I began practicing family law in 1976, at age 24, after graduating with honors from Indiana University School of Law, Indianapolis.

I began my legal career as an intern with the Legal Services Organization of Indiana, in Indianapolis, then as an attorney with VISTA (Volunteers in Service to America). There, and as director of the Legal Aid Society of Evansville, I handled divorces, child custody matters, child abuse and neglect cases, social security appeals and consumer and landlord-tenant cases.

During six years with the Legal Aid Society of Evansville, Indiana, and two more with the Women's Legal Clinic in Highland, Indiana, I handled thousands of divorce and custody cases.

I've now practiced family law in Reno since 1986. With the move to Nevada I eventually limited my practice to family law, which covers an extremely broad range of issues.

My practice has always included a representative cross section of both men and women. I have found that neither sex has a monopoly on honesty, sincerity or love for their children and families. I hope that I have always represented the best interests of my client, no matter which side they are on; however the goal is and should be to assist and guide the parties in reaching the best settlement or outcome for their individual situation.

As an attorney I most enjoy making a positive difference in my clients' lives, as few other professions can. As your attorney, you will find that I am readily accessible, straightforward and honest. My advice and my representation is based on over thirty-five years experience, allowing both a realistic and astute understanding of your case and the family courts. I will make sure you understand your options and have clear expectations, so that you can make the decisions which will have a lasting impact on your life and your children's lives.

I look forward to meeting you!

attorneys.name: John M. Sacco
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Sacco is a graduate of Ohio Wesleyan University, in Delaware, Ohio. Mr. Sacco received his bachelor of arts degree, cum laude, in 1972. His juris doctor degree, cum laude, was obtained from Temple University School of Law, Philadelphia, in 1976.

Mr. Sacco was admitted to the Pennsylvania Bar Association in 1976 (presently inactive). He was admitted to the State Bar of Nevada Bar in 1977. In 1978 Mr. Sacco was admitted to the United States District Court, District of Nevada, and he was also admitted to the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals in 1979.

Mr. Sacco previously served on the Client Security Fund Committee at the State Bar of Nevada and is a founding Pillar of Justice and past member of the Board of Governors of the Nevada Trial Lawyers Association (now the Nevada Justice Association).

Mr. Sacco was a practicing attorney in Nevada since 1977. He tried numerous jury and bench civil trials, and handled many cases before the Nevada Supreme Court. Mr. Sacco participated in numerous arbitrations conducted in Nevada before the American Arbitration Association and within the Nevada Supreme Court's Court Annexed Arbitration Program. He also acted as a private arbitrator and mediator on numerous occasions and was on the panel of the American Arbitration Association. Mr. Sacco had his own law firm for approximately 20 years and became "Of Counsel" to the law firm of Marquis Aurbach Coffing in August, 2001. Recently, Mr. Sacco retired from the practice of law.

attorneys.name: Jordan Schnitzer
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Jordan Schnitzer is a certified Personal Injury Specialist by the State Bar of Nevada. Jordan was born and raised in Las Vegas. He graduated, cum laude, from the W.P. Carey School of Business at Arizona State University with a degree in economics and a minor in communications. He obtained his law degree from the UCLA School of Law, which is consistently ranked as one of the top 20 law schools in the country. He is licensed to practice law in both Nevada and California.

Jordan Schnitzer spent several years working as a lawyer for some of the largest insurance companies and corporations in the country. During that time, Jordan learned all of the tricks and tactics insurance companies use to try to avoid fairly compensating injured people. But Jordan realized he loved helping injured people get the money they deserved instead of helping the greedy insurance companies keep as much as they can.

Jordan’s skill, dedication and passion for helping injured people has made him a go to personal injury attorney by his peers, legal organizations and publications. He has successfully handled cases all the way from pre-litigation settlement, through arbitration, mediation, trial and even the Supreme Court of Nevada.

Jordan has been recognized locally as one of Nevada’s Legal Elite by Nevada Business magazine, a Top Lawyer in Las Vegas by Desert Companion magazine and a Top 100 Lawyer in Las Vegas by MYVEGAS Magazine.

Nationally, Jordan’s qualifications and trial results earned him selection in the exclusive organization The National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 under 40, which is composed of the top trial lawyers who are younger than the age of 40.

Jordan has also been named to the Super Lawyers Rising Stars list. Super Lawyers is a rating service of outstanding lawyers who have attained a high-degree of recognition and professional achievement. The Rising Stars list is reserved for the top 2.5 percent of lawyers who are 40 years old or younger, or have only been in practice for 10 years or less, yet have reached a high level of skill and success.

Jordan has the highest possible Avvo rating: 10.0 Superb. Avvo is one of the most popular online legal services websites. Avvo uses a complex algorithm to assign each lawyer a rating from 1–10 based upon publicly available information, awards and peer reviews. There is no bias in the Avvo rating system and attorneys cannot pay to increase their ratings.

Jordan has attained an AV Preeminent® Rating, which is the pinnacle of professional excellence earned through a strenuous Peer Review Rating process that is managed and monitored by the world’s most trusted legal resource, Martindale-Hubbell®. This award demonstrates that Jordan’s peers have given him the highest possible rating for both legal ability and legal ethics.

Other accolades for Jordan include Top 10 Under 40 by National Academy Of Personal Injury Attorneys, Top 40 Lawyers Under 40 by American Society of Legal Advocates, 10 Best by American Institute of Personal Injury Attorneys and Premier 100 Civil Trial Attorneys by the American Academy of Trial Attorneys.

Jordan enjoys spending time with his family. Jordan is also a big Golden Knights and UNLV fan. He is a long-time booster for the football and basketball program.

attorneys.name: Willi H. Siepmann
attorneys.practice_type: Surety Defense - License Bonds, Payment and Performance Bonds Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Prior to joining The Faux Law Group, Mr. Siepmann worked for over 20 years in insurance defense, during which time he gained significant experience in jury trials, court trials, motion practice and multiple arbitrations. Since he began working at the firm, Mr. Siepmann has been a valuable member of The Faux Law Group team. He has built a strong portfolio of granted motions for summary judgment and motions to dismiss. He has also been successful in persuading claimants to bonds that it was necessary for them to drop their cases when they did not have solid claims, saving both the surety and the claimant the costs of trial.

Mr. Siepmann grew up in Essen, Germany and moved to the United States 43 years ago to study at Brigham Young University. Outside of work, Mr. Siepmann is an avid river rafter and traveler. He has been all over the world, including six trips to Africa and more than twenty to Mexico.

attorneys.name: Sydney A. Soder
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Soder practices in the areas of asset protection, estate planning, probate, estate & gift taxation, business and commercial law, complex civil litigation, guardianship, and trust and estate litigation, representing clients at both the state and federal levels.

Ms. Soder joined Marquis Aurbach as a Law Clerk in 2023, working on a full spectrum of both transactional and litigation matters. She earned her Juris Doctor from the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and was admitted to the State Bar of Nevada in 2025.

Prior to entering law school, Ms. Soder worked as the Managing Paralegal of a local law firm specializing in civil litigation, business law, estate planning, and probate, gaining hands-on experience in a variety of legal matters. While in law school, Ms. Soder served as a research assistant, as the Treasurer and President of the Organization of Psychology and Law, as well as the Events Director for the Organization of Women Law Students. In addition to being named on the Dean’s Honor List, Ms. Soder received CALI Excellence for the Future Awards in the subjects of Professional Responsibility, Disability Law, and Resort and Casino Law.

Outside of her practice, Ms. Soder enjoys exploring the mountains with her Aussie pup, Bandit, cooking and traveling with family and friends, and giving back to her local community. Although a lifelong Vegas native, she can be found cheering on the Eagles - Geaux Birds – along with the Rebs and the Aces. Ms. Soder regularly volunteers for local causes and is a passionate advocate for local youth outreach programs.

attorneys.bio:
Brian K. Steadman primarily focuses his practice in the areas of tax planning, estate planning, business planning and asset protection. Mr. Steadman has had extensive experience in assisting clients with all areas of tax, estate, and charitable planning, including: Wills, Revocable Living Trusts, Powers of Attorney, Special Needs Trusts, Trust Decanting, Gift Trusts for Children and Grandchildren, Generation-Skipping Trusts, Special Needs Trusts, Qualified Personal Residence Trusts, Grantor Retained Income Trusts, Private and Supporting Foundations, Charitable Remainder Trusts, and Charitable Lead Trusts.

In connection with assisting clients with their estate, gift, and family business goals, Mr. Steadman has assisted clients with respect to asset protection planning, including the establishment and maintenance of Nevada Asset Protection Trusts (also known as Nevada Self-Settled Spendthrift Trusts), Family Limited Partnerships, Limited Liability Companies, and Corporations.

Additionally, Mr. Steadman regularly represents beneficiaries and fiduciaries in contested matters and handles all aspects of probate and trust administration.

attorneys.name: Kari L. Stephens
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Kari Stephens is Of Counsel at JEFFREY BURR. Kari completed her undergraduate studies at Oregon State University where she earned a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration (Magna Cum Laude). She went on to study law at Willamette University College of Law, in Salem, Oregon, earning her Juris Doctor (Cum Laude), having graduated fifth in her class. Kari began her legal career at a Portland law firm representing clients in all aspects of trusts and estates. Upon relocating to Las Vegas, Kari joined the Wells Fargo Bank Trust & Investments Center, where she managed the local Trust & Estate Settlement Services department, overseeing the settlement of Trusts over which the Bank had been designated as Trustee. She later joined Goldsmith & Guymon, P.C., as an associate attorney, practicing in the areas of probate and trust administration, estate planning and small business representation. In 2005, Kari joined the trust and estate litigation law firm of Solomon Dwiggins & Freer, Ltd., where she routinely represented fiduciaries, beneficiaries and heirs involving contested matters. Kari was named a partner at Solomon Dwiggins & Freer, Ltd. in 2008.

Kari is actively involved in volunteering her time in the legal community. She has the distinction of being elected as the 2013 President of the Clark County Bar Association having served on the Association's Executive Board since 2006. From 2003 to 2010, Kari acted as a Trustee for the State Bar of Nevada's Client Security Fund, during which period she investigated defalcation claims against attorneys on behalf of the State Bar. Kari is also a member of the Probate and Trust Law section of the State Bar and the Southern Nevada Association of Women Attorneys. Most recently, Kari was elected to the State Bar of Nevada Board of Governor's for a 2 year term.

Kari's practice at JEFFREY BURR focuses on trust administration, probate and estate planning. She is licensed to practice law in Nevada, Oregon and Washington, and before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, the U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada and the U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon. She has been selected as Vegas Inc's 2013 Women to Watch.

She later joined Goldsmith & Guymon, P.C., as an associate attorney, practicing in the areas of probate and trust administration, estate planning and small business representation. In 2005, Kari joined the trust and estate litigation law firm of Solomon Dwiggins & Freer, Ltd., where she routinely represented fiduciaries, beneficiaries and heirs involving contested matters. Kari was named a partner at Solomon Dwiggins & Freer, Ltd. in 2008.

Kari is actively involved in volunteering her time in the legal community. She has the distinction of being elected as the 2013 President of the Clark County Bar Association having served on the Association's Executive Board since 2006. From 2003 to 2010, Kari acted as a Trustee for the State Bar of Nevada's Client Security Fund, during which period she investigated defalcation claims against attorneys on behalf of the State Bar. Kari is also a member of the Probate and Trust Law section of the State Bar and the Southern Nevada Association of Women Attorneys. Most recently, Kari was elected to the State Bar of Nevada Board of Governor's for a 2 year term.

Kari's practice at JEFFREY BURR focuses on trust administration, probate and estate planning. She is licensed to practice law in Nevada, Oregon and Washington, and before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, the U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada and the U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon. She has been selected as Vegas Inc's 2013 Women to Watch.

attorneys.name: Leonard H Stone
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Leonard H. Stone

Founding Partner of Shook & Stone

Leonard Stone is a founding partner of Shook & Stone and has spent more than 29 years handling Catastrophic Injury and Wrongful Death cases involving commercial vehicles, pedestrians, industrial or construction accidents, as well as dangerous conditions of public and private property. Mr. Stone has been licensed to practice law in Nevada since 1995, acting as lead counsel on many multi-million dollar Personal Injury cases during the course of his career over three decades.

Mr. Stone is involved in local, statewide, and national bar associations and public interest groups, serving multiple terms as a member of the Board of the Nevada Justice Association (“NJA”). He currently serves as Chair of the NJA’s Leadership Development, Ethics, Membership committees, and the Trial Lawyers Cares Committee, which engages in good works throughout the State of Nevada. He currently serves as Secretary on the Executive Committee for the NJA, and is in line to become President of the Association. Mr. Stone has testified before the State’s governing bodies in favor of consumer oriented litigation, and supports candidates that believe in protecting our civil liberties.

Mr. Stone’s personal expertise is Personal Injury Litigation. He has successfully obtained numerous multi-million dollar verdicts and settlements from hotel casinos, businesses, property owners, trucking companies, retail establishments, drivers, and insurance carriers. He describes his litigation approach as calculated and relentless, with the ultimate goal of holding tortfeasors accountable for the harms and losses caused by their indifference toward human life.

Mr. Stone previously served as Chairman of the Board of Jewish Nevada, and has held numerous leadership positions with that organization. He is a Past-President of the Jewish Community Center of Southern Nevada, and is the current Chair of the Hebrew Free Loan Committee, a non-profit entity which provides interest-free loans to help people in need of a hand-up, not a hand-out.

In addition, Mr. Stone has been recognized as a leader in the Southern Nevada Community, receiving both the prestigious Vegas Dozen from the Nevada Cancer Institute and multiple leadership awards from the Jewish Community.

Mr. Stone received his Bachelor of Arts degree with honors from Brandeis University in 1991 and his law degree from Loyola Law School in 1995. He began his career as an insurance defense attorney before discovering his passions of promoting justice and fairness for consumers, safeguarding victims’ rights, and strengthening the Civil Justice System. He is actively involved in numerous trial advocacy educational endeavors focusing upon the latest developments in the fields of trial advocacy and communication.

Mr. Stone resides in Las Vegas, Nevada, with his amazing wife Judith, a Marketing Specialist, two unique children (Jonah and Ilana), two cats (Ozzy and Ace), and a Tibetan Terrier (Izzy). Aside from his family, community, and professional interests, Mr. Stone is committed to healthy living, seeking out and cultivating friendships, traveling, and following snow reports with the insatiable goal of first tracks on a bluebird day.

Major Settlements

$4.25m – Wrongful Death claim involving a jaywalking pedestrian struck by a taxicab.

$2.25m – Premises Liability claim against casino involving the failure of a pool’s chlorination system causing lung damage to a tourist/convention attendee.

$2.25m – Back and neck injuries suffered by a woman in a motor vehicle crash.

$2m – Product Liability/Failure to Maintain claims against property owner involving a gate failure causing injuries to a minor child.

$2m – Motor vehicle crash involving a drunk driver causing injuries to multiple passengers of a vehicle.

$1.8m – Medical Malpractice claim against an eye surgeon.

$1.5m – Motor vehicle crash causing multiple injuries to passenger.

$1.25m – Motor vehicle crash causing woman to suffer back injuries.

$1.2m – Injuries suffered by a pedestrian/tourist when struck by a vehicle.

$1m – Premises Liability claim against cleaning company that neglected to use adequate signage while disinfecting a bathroom.

$1m – Wrongful Death claim involving a pedestrian/tourist struck and killed at an intersection in Downtown Las Vegas.

$800k – Wrongful Death claim against a trucking company involving comparative fault.

$500k – Dog Bite claim involving injuries to a contractor working on residential property.

Confidential Settlement – Product Liability/Failure to Maintain claims involving injuries suffered by a hotel employee due to an elevator failure.

David graduated from University of Arizona with a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration degree in 1986. He attended law school at Whittier College School of Law, and graduated in 1990. He also graduated from Golden Gate University with an LL.M. in Taxation in 1991. Most recently, David earned his LL.M. in Entertainment and Media Law from Southwestern Law School in 2016. David’s published works include The Complete Guide to Estate & Financial Planning In Turbulent Times in 2013, Faith-Based Estate Planning in 2008, and co-authored: Love Money Control, Reinventing Estate Planning-2004, Generations, Planning Your Legacy-1999, and Legacy, Plan Protect and Preserve Your Estate-1996.

Since being admitted to practice, David has limited his practice to estate, charitable and asset protection planning. David is very passionate about assisting clients in planning their estates. He is a member of WealthCounsel, LLC, the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, the American Bar Association, the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, Clark County Bar Association, and the Nevada and California State Bar.

David frequently lectures at continuing legal education seminars on topics pertaining to estate planning. Among other topics he has spoken concerning trust law, will law, creditor protection law, and charitable planning issues.

attorneys.bio:
Sander S. Straus is an attorney at the law firm Law Offices of Sander S. Straus, LLC, in Las Vegas, Nevada. He focuses on estate planning and considers his three primary responsibilities to his clients to be advising them, educating them, and keeping the government out of their business as much as possible. With these values guiding his work, he strives to provide exceptional support and service to his customers.

Mr. Straus’s sole area of practice is estate planning, in which he assists clients with a wide range of issues, including but not limited to: creating trusts, drafting wills, ensuring asset protection, facilitating charitable planning, forming businesses, managing estate administration, navigating probate procedures, advising fiduciaries, and forming closely held family entities.

Because of Mr. Straus’s dedication to his clients, they are better equipped to manage their estates, protect their wealth, and pass it on to the next generation. His commitment to their case is exemplified by the time and effort he puts into assisting them in navigating the thorny terrain of estate planning.

attorneys.name: Marissa Temple
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Marissa Temple came to Las Vegas 27 years ago from Mililani, Hawaii–a small town in the center of Oahu. Marissa attended the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, on scholarship and competed as a member of UNLV’s intercollegiate debate team. Marissa had aspirations of being a lawyer from a very young age after witnessing how much her father enjoyed the practice of law. Marissa loves Las Vegas and knew she wanted to begin her practice in Nevada, so she accepted a scholarship to attend UNLV Boyd School of Law as a member of one of the school’s first classes.

During law school, Marissa studied abroad at the University College of London, where she met her husband, Jeff. The two married in 2006 and have two wonderful children, Michael and Scarlett.

Before joining her husband’s injury firm, Marissa spent all 20 years of her practice as a defense litigation attorney representing big companies and major insurance companies. Over 8 years of that time was spent working in-house for a major insurance company and multi-state company defending claims brought by injured individuals, including slip and falls, car accidents, dog bites, wrongful death, and trucking accidents. She knows these companies’ tactics to pay injured individuals as little as possible. She is uniquely qualified to fight insurance adjusters and company representatives on behalf of hurt people to get them the maximum settlement they deserve.

Marissa loves spending time with her husband and kids in her free time. She also loves to run and spends hours a week exploring the beautiful trails throughout Las Vegas. Marissa is a board member for the Nevada Crohn’s and Colitis Foundation and serves Legal Aid of Southern Nevada’s Ask-a-Lawyer program several times a month.

attorneys.name: R. Todd Terry
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Born in Denver, Colorado, Todd received his undergraduate degree in Political Science from the University of Utah in 1994. Todd received his law degree from Quinnipiac College School of Law in Hamden, Connecticut, in 1997. During law school, Todd was a member of the Probate Law Journal and served as its Supervising Editor. He was the recipient of the IOLTA Scholarship. He also received the award for Distinguished Academic Achievement in commercial law and superior classroom performance for his law school career. He was a member of the Phi Delta Phi Honors Fraternity.

After passing the Nevada bar examination in 1997, Todd worked as an associate attorney at large insurance defense firm where he defended cases of medical malpractice and employment discrimination. In 1998, Todd joined a civil litigation firm where he practiced both insurance defense and prosecuted cases on behalf of injured individuals and their families. Since that time, Todd’s interest has been prosecuting personal injury cases.

Between 2002 and 2013, Todd was a partner in two different law firms where he focused on prosecuting personal injury cases on behalf of injured individuals and their families. His firms also represented several corporations defending cases involving premises liability, pharmaceutical negligence and negligent security.

Todd is admitted to practice in the State Courts of Nevada and the United States District Court for the District of Nevada. He is also a member of the United States Court of Federal Claims, the American Trial Lawyers Association, the Nevada Justice Association and served on the Spring Valley Town Advisory Board from 2002 to 2008 including a two year term as chairman.

Todd’s outside interests include spending time with his family and golf.

attorneys.name: Lianna L. Urfalyan
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Lianna Urfalyan has dedicated her entire legal career to complex divorce and child custody matters. She has a well-earned reputation in the Las Vegas legal community for her attention to detail in her legal writings and being a strong advocate for her clients in litigation and settlement conferences.

Ms. Urfalyan is admitted to the State Bar of Nevada and is currently in the process of being certified as a family law specialist. She has co-authored the Hague Convention Chapter for the American Bar Association (ABA) in 2017; The Codex of Family Law Manual to assist new attorneys with specific statutes and case law for the Family Law Conference in Bishop, California in 2018; the ABA publication for Foreign Discovery in 2020; and the State Bar of Nevada divorce information guide in 2023. In 2021, Ms. Urfalyan was distinguished by the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada for her legal contributions and community service.

Attorney Urfalyan received her Juris Doctorate from Southwestern Law School in Los Angeles, California in 2017. While in law school, she received the CALI Excellence for the Future Award for Children and the Law, the Witkin Award for Family Law Procedure and Practice, and the Wiley W. Manuel Certificate for Pro Bono Legal Services by the State Bar of California.

During law school, Ms. Urfalyan also served as a Law Clerk/Judicial Extern to the Honorable Robert Broadbelt III and the Honorable Amy Pellman. She also clerked for three California law firms who practiced solely in family and fertility law.

Prior to achieving her Juris Doctorate, Ms. Urfalyan earned a B.S. in Biology in 2013 and a B.A. in Psychology in 2014, both from the University of Nevada – Las Vegas (UNLV). In addition to English, she is also fluent in Armenian.

Awards and Honors

Honors

CALI Excellence for the Future Award for Children and the Law, April, 2017

Witkin Award for Family Law Procedure and Practice, May, 2017

Wiley W. Manuel Certificate for Pro Bono Legal Services, March, 2017

Jason has been involved in the Boy Scouts of America as a youth leader and is an Eagle Scout.

Jason is a member of the Nevada society of financial service professionals, financial planning association of Nevada, and the southern Nevada estate planning council.

Jason is licensed to practice law in Nevada and Utah.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Law on behalf of injured plaintiffs Lawyers in Reno, NV
attorneys.bio:
Mark Wenzel joined Bradley, Drendel & Jeanney in March 2005. He came to the firm after eight years of trial experience in a law firm where he worked primarily as defense counsel in bad faith cases and personal injury cases. He also brings special expertise to matters involving complex insurance coverage issues. His background and experience makes Mark a valuable resource to our clients, as he provides a unique perspective and understanding of the insurance industry and the manner in which they evaluate, investigate, and litigate personal injury claims. Mark now devotes his practice strictly to personal injury cases, including automobile and trucking cases, product liability, premises liability and insurance bad faith.

After graduating from Gonzaga Law School in 1995, Mark worked for two years as a law clerk in the Nevada Supreme Court prior to focusing his practice in civil law. He is a native of Chicago, Illinois, and received his undergraduate degree from DePaul University in 1990.

attorneys.name: Matthew Whittaker
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Matthew Whittaker is an experienced litigator at Michaelson Law, specializing in contested business and estate matters. With a decade of legal practice, he has represented individuals and businesses in a wide range of disputes, including business litigation, real estate litigation, civil litigation, commercial litigation, and bankruptcy. Matthew’s comprehensive litigation background allows him to skillfully handle lawsuits from start to finish, offering strategic and tailored solutions for his clients.

Matthew began his legal career clerking in the Appellate Unit of the Clark County District Attorney’s Office, where he drafted extensive appellate briefs for cases ranging from minor offenses to complex death penalty matters. This formative experience honed his research and writing skills and provided him with a solid foundation for navigating intricate legal issues.

A proud Nevada native, Matthew has spent most of his life in the state. His family settled in Las Vegas after moving from Sparks when he was two years old. Matthew earned his bachelor’s degree in economics with a minor in political science from Brigham Young University in Provo, Utah, in 2010. He returned to Nevada to attend the William S. Boyd School of Law at UNLV, where he earned his Juris Doctorate.

Since entering private practice, Matthew has developed a reputation for his ability to dissect complex legal challenges and deliver practical, effective solutions. His dedication to understanding each client’s unique circumstances enables him to achieve favorable outcomes in even the most contentious disputes.

attorneys.name: Shann D. Winesett
attorneys.practice_type: Domestic Relations Lawyers in Henderson, NV
attorneys.bio:
Shann D. Winesett completed his undergraduate studies locally at the University of Nevada Las Vegas, where he graduated magnum cum laude with a bachelor's degree in English literature in 1988. After completing his undergraduate studies, Mr. Winesett spent two years in Germany studying philosophy and law at the Ludwig-Maximilians University in Munich. Mr. Winesett returned to the United States in 1990 to attend Loyola Law School in Los Angeles, California, where he earned his juris doctor degree in 1993. Mr. Winesett completed the American Bar Association's Family Advocacy Institute in 1998.

After graduating from law school, Mr. Winesett practiced law in Los Angeles with the national law firm Robins Kaplan Miller & Ciresi until returning to Las Vegas with his family in 1997. While primarily practicing in Nevada, Mr. Winesett maintains his license to practice law in California. Mr. Winesett is admitted to the United States Supreme Court and United States District Court for the Districts of Nevada and Central California.

In 2001, 2004, and 2005, Mr. Winesett received commendations from the United States Congress for his service to the community. In 2004, Mr. Winesett also received the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada's Louis Wiener Award for his representation of victims of domestic violence. Mr. Winesett is a contributing editor to the Nevada Family Law Practice Manual and is a member of the Executive Council for the Family Law Section of the Nevada State Bar Association.

Mr. Winesett represents clients in all forms of domestic relations matters, including divorce, complex custody disputes, relocation litigation, paternity, adoptions, post-divorce modifications of custody, visitation, child support, and alimony. Mr. Winesett also operates Las Vegas QDRO, a business entity that assists litigants and attorneys in dividing retirement assets upon divorce.

attorneys.name: Patti S. Wise Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: Edward M. Bernstein & Associates Accident and Injury Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Accidents Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
About Patti

As Managing Partner for the firm, Patti has been instrumental in assisting thousands of people with their accident and injury claims.

For over 25 years, she has worked primarily in Mass Tort and Personal Injury cases, with an emphasis on brain injuries, seriously injured plaintiffs, and pharmaceutical litigation. In addition, Patti was one of the lead attorneys in the litigation against the Endoscopy Center of Southern Nevada.

Patti was born in Cheyenne, Wyoming, and attended the University of Wyoming where she received a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology, Phi Beta Kappa. She continued her education at the University of Wyoming, College of Law, and received her Juris Doctorate in 1995. While in law school, Patti was a published comment author and a member of Law Review.

Patti’s achievements

In 2011, Patti was trial co-counsel in Washington v. Teva which resulted in a $104 million verdict (the 7th largest verdict in the United States). She has been selected as one of Nevada’s Top 100 Trial Attorneys from 2007 to present by the American Trial Lawyers Association. Patti was a speaker at the 2012 and 2014 Nevada Justice Association annual convention and is a court appointed arbitrator for Clark County.

For assistance with your case, connect with experienced Las Vegas personal injury lawyers. If you’ve been involved in a motor vehicle accident in Nevada, our Las Vegas car accident lawyer page offers specialized resources and support.

attorneys.name: Nick Wooldridge
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
As an experienced and knowledgeable Las Vegas criminal defense attorney, Nick Wooldridge has a long track record of representing clients accused of serious federal and state crimes. Mr. Wooldridge firmly believes that every client deserve to be considered innocent until proven guilty, and is committed to providing legal representation to every criminal defendant whether you've been accused of a misdemeanor or a serious felony offense. Mr. Wooldridge can help you if you have been accused of:

Prostitution

Sex crimes

Possession of marijuana

DUI

Assault or battery

Domestic violence

Theft

Fraud

Murder

The police and prosecutor are not your friends and aren't looking out for your interests if you are suspected of a crime. Police want to close cases and prosecutors want to get convictions. There are many people in jail or prison for offenses that they did not commit, or serving harsh sentences for minor crimes, because of law enforcement efforts to appear tough on crime.

You do not want your life ruined by criminal charges, and you need to fight hard to avoid a conviction or minimize the penalties you face. This means finding an experienced Las Vegas criminal defense lawyer who will help you.

Getting Legal Help from a Las Vegas Criminal Defense Lawyer

Nick Wooldridge provides personalized one-on-one attention to defendants accused of violating the law. Mr. Wooldridge will meet with you, review the evidence, investigate the facts and circumstances of the alleged crime, and help you to develop a strategy for responding to charges.

You may be able to get charges dropped before a trial, or convince a court to find you not guilty of an offense- Mr. Wooldridge will help you to explore all possible defenses, ways to introduce reasonable doubt, and arguments to make to avoid conviction. Mr. Wooldridge can also help to explore options for pre-trial diversion programs or can assist you in negotiating a plea agreement with the prosecutor who is pressing charges against you.

Whether you have been accused of a state crime or a federal offense, don't leave your case to chance and don't rely on the advice of friends and family who may have learned everything they know by watching crime shows on TV. Get legal help from someone with the knowledge, background, and legal skills to give you informed advice and act as a tough advocate for you. Call Nick Wooldridge today to schedule a consultation and learn more about how a Las Vegas criminal defense lawyer can help with your case.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio: John's practice also covers all aspects of the criminal process. In addition, he has substantial experience and success in the criminal appeals and post conviction arena. John was first admitted to practice law in the State of Hawaii in 1991 where he acted as a Court appointed defense counsel and was approved to handle all classes of felonies and appeals. He later became licensed to practice law in Nevada and has been working as a criminal defense lawyer in Las Vegas since 1997. He has handled cases before the Hawaii and Nevada Supreme Courts and the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. John received a B.A. from the University of Hawaii at Manoa in 1988, and his Doctor of Jurisprudence from West Virginia University, College of Law in 1991. He also is a personal injury lawyer in Las Vegas and can help if you have been injured as a result of negligence on the part of someone else.

Andrew D. Yates joined the firm as a Law Clerk in 2023.He became an associate in 2024 after he passed the Nevada Bar Exam. Andrew graduated from the William S. Boyd School of Law at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2024.

During his time in law school, Andrew was able to serve as a student attorney at the Poverty Law & Policy Clinic, a Thomas and Mack Legal Clinic, where he had the opportunity to work with public entities and private organizations on poverty law issues related to real estate and access to healthcare. Andrew also had the opportunity to work as a Judicial Intern for two Nevada judges during his time in law school. Under the Honorable Susan H. Johnson in the Eighth Judicial District Court of Nevada, Andrew gained experience in business court and other civil cases. Under the Honorable Chief Judge Jerry A. Weiss, Andrew gained exposure to both civil and criminal issues including specialty courts.

When he is not at work, Andrew is usually spending time with his family or friends. Andrew’s hobbies include snowboarding, basketball, shooting, cars, and traveling to visit his loved ones.

attorneys.name: Ida M. Ybarra Esq
attorneys.firm_name: Benson & Bingham Accident Injury Lawyers, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Las Vegas, NV
attorneys.bio:
Ida is originally from the small farming town of Corcoran, California. She attended the University of California, Berkeley where she earned her Bachelor of Arts degree in social welfare with an emphasis in psychology and a minor in Chicana/o Studies. She went on to earn her Juris Doctor degree from Thomas Jefferson School of Law. During law school, Ida studied abroad in Nice, France where she was taught international constitutional law by the late Justice Scalia of the Supreme Court of the United States.

Ida previously worked at a personal injury firm where she created and managed the workers' compensation department. She also worked as a workers' compensation insurance adjuster for several insurance companies. Her prior experience has allowed her to advocate for the rights of her clients.

When Ida is not practicing law, she enjoys traveling the world, watching college basketball and football and reading.

Ida is admitted to practice law in Nevada and is a member of the Nevada State Bar, Nevada Federal District Court and 9th Circuit Court of Appeals.
